name: nuclear_symmetry_energy_and_pves_synthesis
source_slice:
theorem nuclear_symmetry_energy_and_pves_synthesis
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (e₀ c₁ S_sym : ℤ) :
    let σ_R := protonSheetCore P A C
    let σ_L := neutronSheetCore P A C
    let V₀ := isoscalarCoreOp P A C
    let Δ := isovectorAsymmetryOp P A C
    let Φ := chargeSymmetryBridge P A C
    let τ₃ := isospinGrading P
    -- 1. PVES Sum/Difference & Isospin Grading Lock:
    σ_R + σ_L = V₀ ∧
    σ_R - σ_L = Δ ∧
    Δ = τ₃ * V₀ ∧
    -- 2. Relativistic Pseudospin Commutation vs. Anticommutation:
    opComm Φ V₀ = 0 ∧
    opAnticomm Φ Δ = 0 ∧
    -- 3. Charge-Symmetry Parity of V₀ (+1), Δ (-1), and Quadratic Symmetry Energy Δ² = V₀² (+1):
    chargeSymmetryConj P A C V₀ = V₀ * V₀ ∧
    chargeSymmetryConj P A C Δ = -(V₀ * Δ) ∧
    Δ * Δ = V₀ * V₀ ∧
    -- 4. Parabolic EoS Charge-Symmetry Selection Rule:
    (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A =
       chargeExchangePlus P A →
     chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C =
       chargeExchangeMinus P C →
      nuclearEoSOperator P A C e₀ c₁ S_sym -
        chargeSymmetryConj P A C (nuclearEoSOperator P A C e₀ c₁ S_sym) =
        ((2 : ℤ) * c₁) • Δ ∧
      chargeSymmetryConj P A C (nuclearEoSOperator P A C e₀ 0 S_sym) =
        nuclearEoSOperator P A C e₀ 0 S_sym) := by
  intro σ_R σ_L V₀ Δ Φ τ₃
  have hPVES_sum : σ_R + σ_L = V₀ := rfl
  have hPVES_diff : σ_R - σ_L = Δ := rfl
  have hLock : Δ = τ₃ * V₀ := by
    change isovectorAsymmetryOp P A C = isospinGrading P * isoscalarCoreOp P A C
    unfold isovectorAsymmetryOp isospinGrading isoscalarCoreOp opComm opAnticomm
           chargeExchangePlus chargeExchangeMinus
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, add_mul, mul_add, one_mul, mul_one,
               mul_assoc, hP, op_P_mul_P_assoc hP]
    abel
  have hPseudoComm : opComm Φ V₀ = 0 := by
    change opComm (chargeSymmetryBridge P A C) (isoscalarCoreOp P A C) = 0
    unfold opComm chargeSymmetryBridge isoscalarCoreOp opAnticomm
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, mul_assoc,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero_assoc hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero_assoc hP,
               mul_zero, zero_mul]
    abel
  have hPseudoAnti : opAnticomm Φ Δ = 0 := by
    change opAnticomm (chargeSymmetryBridge P A C) (isovectorAsymmetryOp P A C) = 0
    unfold opAnticomm chargeSymmetryBridge isovectorAsymmetryOp opComm
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero_assoc hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero_assoc hP,
               mul_zero, zero_mul]
    abel
  have hConjV : chargeSymmetryConj P A C V₀ = V₀ * V₀ := by
    change chargeSymmetryBridge P A C * isoscalarCoreOp P A C * chargeSymmetryBridge P A C =
           isoscalarCoreOp P A C * isoscalarCoreOp P A C
    unfold chargeSymmetryBridge isoscalarCoreOp opAnticomm
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, mul_assoc,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero_assoc hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero_assoc hP,
               mul_zero, zero_mul]
    abel
  have hConjDelta : chargeSymmetryConj P A C Δ = -(V₀ * Δ) := by
    change chargeSymmetryBridge P A C * isovectorAsymmetryOp P A C * chargeSymmetryBridge P A C =
           -(isoscalarCoreOp P A C * isovectorAsymmetryOp P A C)
    unfold chargeSymmetryBridge isovectorAsymmetryOp isoscalarCoreOp opComm opAnticomm
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero_assoc hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero_assoc hP,
               mul_zero, zero_mul]
    abel
  have hDeltaSq : Δ * Δ = V₀ * V₀ := by
    change isovectorAsymmetryOp P A C * isovectorAsymmetryOp P A C =
           isoscalarCoreOp P A C * isoscalarCoreOp P A C
    unfold isovectorAsymmetryOp isoscalarCoreOp opComm opAnticomm
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero_assoc hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero_assoc hP,
               mul_zero, zero_mul]
    abel
  refine ⟨hPVES_sum, hPVES_diff, hLock, hPseudoComm, hPseudoAnti,
          hConjV, hConjDelta, hDeltaSq, ?_⟩
  intro hReflPlus hReflMinus
  have hVZig : V₀ * chargeExchangePlus P A = chargeExchangePlus P A := by
    change (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C +
            chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A) * chargeExchangePlus P A =
           chargeExchangePlus P A
    calc (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C +
          chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A) * chargeExchangePlus P A
      _ = chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A +
          chargeExchangeMinus P C * (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangePlus P A) := by
          simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = chargeExchangePlus P A := by
          rw [chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, mul_zero, add_zero, hReflPlus]
  have hVZag : V₀ * chargeExchangeMinus P C = chargeExchangeMinus P C := by
    change (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C +
            chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A) * chargeExchangeMinus P C =
           chargeExchangeMinus P C
    calc (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C +
          chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A) * chargeExchangeMinus P C
      _ = chargeExchangePlus P A * (chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangeMinus P C) +
          chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C := by
          simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = chargeExchangeMinus P C := by
          rw [chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP, mul_zero, zero_add, hReflMinus]
  have hVV : V₀ * V₀ = V₀ := by
    change V₀ * (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C +
                 chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A) = V₀
    rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hVZig, ← mul_assoc, hVZag]
    rfl
  have hVDelta : V₀ * Δ = Δ := by
    change V₀ * (chargeExchangePlus P A * chargeExchangeMinus P C -
                 chargeExchangeMinus P C * chargeExchangePlus P A) = Δ
    rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, hVZig, ← mul_assoc, hVZag]
    rfl
  have hConjLin : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (X Y : B),
      chargeSymmetryConj P A C (a • X + b • Y) =
      a • chargeSymmetryConj P A C X + b • chargeSymmetryConj P A C Y := by
    intro a b X Y
    unfold chargeSymmetryConj
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
  have hConjV_id : chargeSymmetryConj P A C V₀ = V₀ := by rw [hConjV, hVV]
  have hConjDelta_neg : chargeSymmetryConj P A C Δ = -Δ := by rw [hConjDelta, hVDelta]
  have hConjDeltaSq : chargeSymmetryConj P A C (Δ * Δ) = Δ * Δ := by
    rw [hDeltaSq, hVV, hConjV_id]
  have hEoS_eval : ∀ k₁ : ℤ,
      chargeSymmetryConj P A C (nuclearEoSOperator P A C e₀ k₁ S_sym) =
      e₀ • V₀ - k₁ • Δ + S_sym • (Δ * Δ) := by
    intro k₁
    unfold nuclearEoSOperator
    change chargeSymmetryConj P A C (1 • (e₀ • V₀ + k₁ • Δ) + S_sym • (Δ * Δ)) = _
    rw [hConjLin 1 S_sym (e₀ • V₀ + k₁ • Δ) (Δ * Δ),
        hConjLin e₀ k₁ V₀ Δ, one_smul,
        hConjV_id, hConjDelta_neg, hConjDeltaSq, smul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hEoS_eval c₁]
    unfold nuclearEoSOperator
    change (e₀ • V₀ + c₁ • Δ + S_sym • (Δ * Δ)) -
           (e₀ • V₀ - c₁ • Δ + S_sym • (Δ * Δ)) = ((2 : ℤ) * c₁) • Δ
    rw [mul_smul, two_zsmul]
    abel
  · rw [hEoS_eval 0]
    unfold nuclearEoSOperator
    change e₀ • V₀ - (0 : ℤ) • Δ + S_sym • (Δ * Δ) =
           e₀ • V₀ + (0 : ℤ) • Δ + S_sym • (Δ * Δ)
    simp only [zero_smul, sub_zero, add_zero]

end NuclearAstrophysicsSymmetrySynthesis

def majoranaPhaseConjChannel (P A C_Maj X : B) : B :=
  chargeExchangePlus P A * X * chargeExchangePlus P A +
  chargeExchangeMinus P C_Maj * X * chargeExchangeMinus P C_Maj

/-- **Theorem LXXII.1 (Chirality Selection Rule: Bare `ΔT_z = 2` Vanishes Without Majorana Mass):**
For ANY nucleon projection `P * P = P` and ANY two `β⁻` transition amplitudes `A₁, A₂ : B`:
1. Direct two-step `β⁻` transitions without an intermediate `(1 - P) * C_Maj * P` bridge vanish
   identically due to chiral/isospin orthogonality `(1 - P) * P = 0`:
   `chargeExchangePlus P A₁ * chargeExchangePlus P A₂ = 0`,
2. Consequently, the bare superposition square `(N_{+,1} + N_{+,2})² = 0` vanishes identically,
3. Inserting the identity `1` or any purely diagonal operator `P * D * P` between `N_{+,1}` and
   `N_{+,2}` ALSO vanishes: `N_{+,1} * (P * D * P) * N_{+,2} = 0`! -/

theorem bare_double_beta_chirality_selection_rule
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A₁ A₂ D : B) :
    chargeExchangePlus P A₁ * chargeExchangePlus P A₂ = 0 ∧
    (chargeExchangePlus P A₁ + chargeExchangePlus P A₂) *
      (chargeExchangePlus P A₁ + chargeExchangePlus P A₂) = 0 ∧
    chargeExchangePlus P A₁ * (P * D * P) * chargeExchangePlus P A₂ = 0 := by
  refine ⟨chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP A₁ A₂, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [add_mul, mul_add, chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, add_zero]
  · unfold chargeExchangePlus
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one,
               mul_assoc, hP, op_P_mul_P_assoc hP]
    abel

/-- **Theorem LXXII.2 (The Schechter–Valle `0νββ` Black-Box Theorem & DCE Polarization Identity):**
Let `P * P = P` be the nucleon projection, `N₊ = chargeExchangePlus P A` be the `β⁻` vertex, and
`M_Maj = chargeExchangeMinus P C_Maj` be the Majorana neutrino mass insertion. Then:
1. **Factorization Through the Majorana Mass Core `V_Maj = isoscalarCoreOp P A C_Maj`:**
   `neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj = V_Maj * N₊` AND `= N₊ * V_Maj`!
2. **The Schechter–Valle Black-Box Implication (`0νββ ≠ 0 → Majorana Mass ≠ 0`):**
   If the `0νββ` transition operator is non-zero (`neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj ≠ 0`),
   then BOTH the Majorana insertion `M_Maj = chargeExchangeMinus P C_Maj ≠ 0` AND the induced
   Majorana mass core `V_Maj = isoscalarCoreOp P A C_Maj ≠ 0` are strictly non-zero!
3. **DCE Two-Channel Polarization Identity:**
   The two-nucleon DCE operator `dceMajoranaOp P A₁ A₂ C_Maj` is the exact polarization of the
   single-channel `0νββ` operator:
   `neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P (A₁ + A₂) C_Maj =`
   `neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A₁ C_Maj + neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A₂ C_Maj + dceMajoranaOp P A₁ A₂ C_Maj`,
4. **Majorana Phase-Conjugate Channel Unification (`Ψ_pc(Φ) = O_{0νβ⁻β⁻} + O_{0νβ⁺β⁺} = V_Maj * Φ`):**

theorem schechter_valle_black_box_and_dce_synthesis
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A A₁ A₂ C_Maj : B) :
    let N₊ := chargeExchangePlus P A
    let M_Maj := chargeExchangeMinus P C_Maj
    let V_Maj := isoscalarCoreOp P A C_Maj
    let Φ := chargeSymmetryBridge P A C_Maj
    neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj = V_Maj * N₊ ∧
    neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj = N₊ * V_Maj ∧
    (neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj ≠ 0 → M_Maj ≠ 0 ∧ V_Maj ≠ 0) ∧
    neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P (A₁ + A₂) C_Maj =
      neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A₁ C_Maj +
      neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A₂ C_Maj +
      dceMajoranaOp P A₁ A₂ C_Maj ∧
    majoranaPhaseConjChannel P A C_Maj Φ =
      neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj +
      (M_Maj * N₊ * M_Maj) ∧
    majoranaPhaseConjChannel P A C_Maj Φ = V_Maj * Φ := by
  intro N₊ M_Maj V_Maj Φ
  have hLeftV : neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj = V_Maj * N₊ := by
    unfold neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp V_Maj isoscalarCoreOp opAnticomm
    simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc, chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hRightV : neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj = N₊ * V_Maj := by
    unfold neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp V_Maj isoscalarCoreOp opAnticomm
    simp only [mul_add, mul_assoc, chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero_assoc hP, add_zero]
  have hBlackBox : neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj ≠ 0 → M_Maj ≠ 0 ∧ V_Maj ≠ 0 := by
    intro hNe0
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hM0
      apply hNe0
      unfold neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp
      change N₊ * M_Maj * N₊ = 0
      rw [hM0, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · intro hV0
      apply hNe0
      rw [hLeftV, hV0, zero_mul]
  have hPlusAdd :
      chargeExchangePlus P (A₁ + A₂) =
      chargeExchangePlus P A₁ + chargeExchangePlus P A₂ := by
    unfold chargeExchangePlus
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul]
  have hDCE :
      neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P (A₁ + A₂) C_Maj =
      neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A₁ C_Maj +
      neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A₂ C_Maj +
      dceMajoranaOp P A₁ A₂ C_Maj := by
    unfold neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp dceMajoranaOp
    rw [hPlusAdd]
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add]
    abel
  have hPC_sum :
      majoranaPhaseConjChannel P A C_Maj Φ =
      neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp P A C_Maj + (M_Maj * N₊ * M_Maj) := by
    unfold majoranaPhaseConjChannel Φ chargeSymmetryBridge neutrinolessDoubleBetaOp
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero_assoc hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero_assoc hP,
               mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hPC_VPhi : majoranaPhaseConjChannel P A C_Maj Φ = V_Maj * Φ := by
    rw [hPC_sum, hLeftV]
    unfold V_Maj isoscalarCoreOp opAnticomm Φ chargeSymmetryBridge
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc,
               chargeExchangePlus_sq_zero hP, chargeExchangeMinus_sq_zero hP,

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :

    conjPlus P A (genV P A C) = genV P A C ∧

    comm H (U * V) = comm H U * V + U * comm H V ∧

    comm H (anticomm U V) - anticomm U (comm H V) = anticomm (comm H U) V ∧
    comm H (anticomm H U) = comm (H * H) U ∧
    anticomm H (comm H U) = comm (H * H) U := by

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    conePlus P A * conePlus P A = 0 ∧
    coneMinus P C * coneMinus P C = 0 ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C = genV P A C ∧
    genJ P A C * genJ P A C = -genV P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C + genJ P A C * genJ P A C = 0 ∧
    genJ P A C * genPhi P A C = genSig P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genJ P A C = -genSig P A C ∧
    anticomm (genPhi P A C) (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    genSig P A C = invS P * genV P A C ∧
    genV P A C = invS P * genSig P A C ∧
    genSig P A C * genSig P A C = genV P A C * genV P A C ∧

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    -- 1. Cayley–Weyl Unitarity Defect (`W * W_inv - 1 = V² - V`):
    weylJ P A C * weylJInv P A C - 1 =

      genV P A C * genV P A C - genV P A C ∧

    -- 2. Exact Block-Swapping Weyl Reflection (`J * P₁₁(V) * (-J) = P₀₀(V²)`):
    genJ P A C * peirce11 P (genV P A C) * (-genJ P A C) =

    genJ P A C * peirce00 P (genV P A C) * (-genJ P A C) =
      peirce11 P (genV P A C * genV P A C) ∧

      peirce00 P (genV P A C * genV P A C) ∧

      P - genJ P A C - genSig P A C - conePlus P A +

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :

      (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * coneMinus P C) ∧
    jordanTriple (genPhi P A C) (genPhi P A C) (genPhi P A C) =
      (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C) ∧

For ANY binary idempotent `P * P = P` (`idemDefect P = 0`) and ANY `A, C : B`:
1. **Exact Golden-Mean Idempotency Defect (`δ(P + Φ) = +V` and `δ(P + J) = -V`):**

   - `idemDefect (goldenOpConj P A C) = genV P A C` (`T̄_Ω² = T̄_Ω + V`!),
   - `idemDefect (goldenOpJ P A C) = -genV P A C` (`T_J² = T_J - V`!).
2. **Exact Non-Commutative Vieta–Binet Relations (`T_Ω + T̄_Ω = 1` and `T_Ω * T̄_Ω = -V`):**

3. **Centrality of `V` with `T_Ω` (`[V, T_Ω] = 0`) & Exact `V`-Fibonacci Recurrence:**
   - `comm (genV P A C) (goldenOp P A C) = 0`,
   - `T_Ω³ = T_Ω² + V * T_Ω = (1 + V) * T_Ω + V`,
   - `T_Ω⁴ = T_Ω³ + V * T_Ω² = (1 + (2 : ℤ) • V) * T_Ω + V + V * V`!

theorem archetype_A37_golden_mean_transfer_operator_and_fibonacci_recurrence
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    let T   := goldenOp P A C
    let Tb  := goldenOpConj P A C
    let TJ  := goldenOpJ P A C
    let V   := genV P A C
    -- 1. Exact Idempotency Defects `δ(P + Φ) = +V`, `δ((1 - P) - Φ) = +V`, `δ(P + J) = -V`:
    idemDefect T = V ∧
    idemDefect Tb = V ∧
    idemDefect TJ = -V ∧
    -- 2. Vieta–Binet Sum and Product Relations:
    T + Tb = 1 ∧
    T * Tb = -V ∧
    Tb * T = -V ∧
    comm V T = 0 ∧
    -- 3. Non-Commutative `V`-Fibonacci Power Recurrence (`T³ = (1 + V) T + V`, `T⁴ = (1 + 2V) T + V + V²`):
    T * T * T = (1 + V) * T + V ∧
    T * T * T * T = (1 + (2 : ℤ) • V) * T + V + V * V ∧
    -- 4. Binet–Lucas Moment Sums (`L₁ = 1`, `L₂ = 1 + 2V`, `L₃ = 1 + 3V`):
    (T * T + Tb * Tb) = 1 + (2 : ℤ) • V ∧
    (T * T * T + Tb * Tb * Tb) = 1 + (3 : ℤ) • V := by
  intro T Tb TJ V
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    (dsimp [T, Tb, TJ, V]; peirce_abel_omega hP)

end PureNonCommutativeOperatorSpine

theorem stage_C1_leibniz_jacobi_and_defect_tower (H U V X : B) :
    comm H (U * V) = comm H U * V + U * comm H V ∧
    comm H (U * V) = anticomm H U * V - U * anticomm H V ∧
    comm H (comm U V) + comm U (comm V H) + comm V (comm H U) = 0 ∧
    comm H (anticomm U V) - anticomm U (comm H V) = anticomm (comm H U) V ∧
    comm H (anticomm H U) = comm (H * H) U ∧
    idemDefect (1 - X) = idemDefect X ∧
    idemDefect (-X) * idemDefect X = idemDefect (X * X) ∧
    idemDefect X * idemDefect (-X) = idemDefect (X * X) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    (simp only [idemDefect, comm, anticomm, sub_neg_eq_add, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg,
                add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one, mul_assoc]; abel)

    coneMinus P C * coneMinus P C = 0 ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C = genV P A C ∧
    genJ P A C * genJ P A C = -genV P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C + genJ P A C * genJ P A C = 0 ∧
    genJ P A C * genPhi P A C = genSig P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genJ P A C = -genSig P A C ∧
    anticomm (genPhi P A C) (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    genSig P A C = invS P * genV P A C ∧
    genSig P A C * genSig P A C = genV P A C * genV P A C ∧
    comm (conePlus P A) (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    comm (coneMinus P C) (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    comm (genPhi P A C) (genJ P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • genSig P A C) ∧
    comm (genSig P A C) (genPhi P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C) ∧
    comm (genSig P A C) (genJ P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

name: stage_C4_sandwich_trinity_and_superoperator_ladders

theorem stage_C4_sandwich_trinity_and_superoperator_ladders
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    sandwichCross P A C X + sandwichSame P A C X = genPhi P A C * X * genPhi P A C ∧
    sandwichCross P A C X - sandwichSame P A C X = -(genJ P A C * X * genJ P A C) ∧
    (2 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • sandwichCross P A C X - anticomm (genV P A C) X) =
      derivSqPhi P A C X + derivSqJ P A C X ∧
    derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqJ P A C X = (4 : ℤ) • sandwichSame P A C X ∧
    ladderMinus P A C (genPhi P A C) = -((4 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C)) ∧
    ladderMinus P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    ladderPlus P A C (genJ P A C) = (4 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C) ∧
    ladderPlus P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    ladderMinus P A C X - ladderPlus P A C X = -((2 : ℤ) • comm (genSig P A C) X) ∧
    ladderSum P A C (ladderSum P A C (genPhi P A C)) =
      -((16 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genPhi P A C)) ∧
    ladderSum P A C (ladderSum P A C (genJ P A C)) =
      -((16 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genJ P A C)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

theorem stage_C5_homogenized_projectors_and_second_order_orthogonality
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    hProjV P A C X + hProjPhi P A C X + hProjJ P A C X + hProjSig P A C X =
      (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * X) ∧
    hProjV P A C (genV P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genV P A C) ∧
    hProjV P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjV P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjV P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genPhi P A C) ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genJ P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genJ P A C) ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genSig P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genSig P A C) ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C)) =
      (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C)) ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (hProjJ P A C (genJ P A C)) = 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>

theorem stage_C6_noncommutative_galois_fourier_and_weyl_covariance
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X Y : B) :
    zornConj P (X * Y) = zornConj P X * zornConj P Y ∧
    hProjV P A C (genV P A C)     = fourierV P A C (genV P A C) ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C) = fourierPhi P A C (genPhi P A C) ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genJ P A C)     = fourierJ P A C (genJ P A C) ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genSig P A C) = fourierSig P A C (genSig P A C) ∧
    grpPhi P A C (grpJ P A C (genPhi P A C)) = grpId P A C (grpSig P A C (genPhi P A C)) ∧
    grpPhi P A C (grpJ P A C (genJ P A C))   = grpId P A C (grpSig P A C (genJ P A C)) ∧
    grpPhi P A C (grpJ P A C (genSig P A C)) = grpId P A C (grpSig P A C (genSig P A C)) ∧
    hProjV P A C (genJ P A C * X * (-genJ P A C)) =
      genJ P A C * hProjV P A C X * (-genJ P A C) ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C * X * genPhi P A C) =
      genPhi P A C * hProjPhi P A C X * genPhi P A C ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genSig P A C * X * genSig P A C) =
      genSig P A C * hProjSig P A C X * genSig P A C := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A₁ A₂ C X : B) :
    conjPlus P A₁ (conjPlusInv P A₁ X) = X ∧
    conjPlus P A₁ (conjPlus P A₂ X) = conjPlus P (A₁ + A₂) X ∧
    conjPlus P A₁ (genV P A₁ C) = genV P A₁ C ∧

    steinbergBraid P A₁ C * steinbergBraidInv P A₁ C = 1 ∧
    steinbergBraidInv P A₁ C * steinbergBraid P A₁ C = 1 ∧
    steinbergBraid P A₁ C - steinbergBraidDual P A₁ C =

theorem stage_C8_operator_moebius_cross_ratio_and_bergman_hua
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    moebiusBruhat P A C * moebiusBruhatInv P A C = 1 ∧
    moebiusBruhatInv P A C * moebiusBruhat P A C = 1 ∧
    moebiusConj P A C P * moebiusConj P A C P = moebiusConj P A C P ∧
    moebiusConj P A C (genV P A C) = genV P A C ∧
    idemTransv P C - idemTrans P A = genPhi P A C ∧
    (idemTransv P C - idemTrans P A) * (idemTransv P C - idemTrans P A) = genV P A C ∧
    crossRatio P P (idemTrans P A) (idemTransv P C) = -genV P A C ∧
    crossRatio (moebiusConj P A C P) (moebiusConj P A C P)
      (moebiusConj P A C (idemTrans P A)) (moebiusConj P A C (idemTransv P C)) =
      -genV P A C ∧
    bergmanHua (idemTrans P A) (idemTransv P C) = 1 - genV P A C ∧
    bergmanHua (idemTrans P A) (idemTransv P C) = bergmanOp P A C 1 ∧
    conjPlus P A (1 - qgtMinus P A C) = conjMinusInv P C (1 - qgtPlus P A C) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

theorem stage_C9_hodge_de_rham_complex_and_star_duality
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    superDerivPlus P A (superDerivPlus P A X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivMinus P C (superDerivMinus P C X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivPlusBar P A (superDerivPlusBar P A X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivMinusBar P C (superDerivMinusBar P C X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivPlusBar P A X = -hodgeStar P (superDerivPlus P A (hodgeStar P X)) ∧
    superDerivMinusBar P C X = -hodgeStar P (superDerivMinus P C (hodgeStar P X)) ∧
    superDerivPhiBar P A C X = -hodgeStar P (superDerivPhi P A C (hodgeStar P X)) ∧
    hodgeLaplacianPhi P A C X = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * X) ∧
    superDerivPhi P A C (invS P) = -((2 : ℤ) • genJ P A C) ∧
    superDerivPhi P A C (genPhi P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • genV P A C ∧
    superDerivPhi P A C (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    superDerivPhiBar P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧
    (2 : ℤ) • hProjPhi P A C X =
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P A C (derivSqPhi P A C X) -
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P A C (derivSqJ P A C X) -
      (2 : ℤ) • derivSqSig P A C X := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-! ### Stage C₁₀: Golden Transfer Operator `T_Ω = P + Φ`, Defect `δ(T_Ω) = V` & Biquadratic Galois Norm -/

name: stage_C10_golden_transfer_and_biquadratic_galois_norm

theorem stage_C10_golden_transfer_and_biquadratic_galois_norm
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    -- 1. Golden Transfer Defects `δ(P + Φ) = +V`, `δ((1 - P) - Φ) = +V`, `δ(P + J) = -V`:
    idemDefect (goldenOp P A C) = genV P A C ∧
    idemDefect (goldenOpConj P A C) = genV P A C ∧
    idemDefect (goldenOpJ P A C) = -genV P A C ∧
    -- 2. Vieta–Binet Relations & `V`-Fibonacci Power Recurrence:
    goldenOp P A C + goldenOpConj P A C = 1 ∧
    goldenOp P A C * goldenOpConj P A C = -genV P A C ∧
    goldenOp P A C * goldenOp P A C * goldenOp P A C =
      (1 + genV P A C) * goldenOp P A C + genV P A C ∧
    -- 3. Zorn–Galois Conjugates `V ± Φ = δ(∓Φ)` & Biquadratic 4-Conjugate Galois Norm `δ(V²)`:
    idemDefect (genPhi P A C) = genV P A C - genPhi P A C ∧
    idemDefect (-genPhi P A C) = genV P A C + genPhi P A C ∧
    galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genPhi P A C) = idemDefect (genV P A C) ∧
    galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genJ P A C) = idemDefect (-genV P A C) ∧
    galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genPhi P A C) *
      galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genJ P A C) =
      idemDefect (genV P A C * genV P A C) ∧
    idemDefect (genV P A C) =
      idemDefect (qgtPlus P A C) + idemDefect (qgtMinus P A C) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-! ### Archetype A₃₉: Mandelbrot Defect Iteration `δ(δ(X))` & Dyadic Telescoping Towers -/

/-- **Theorem A₃₉.1 (Mandelbrot Defect Iteration `δ(δ(X))` & Dyadic Telescoping Product Tower):**
For ANY idempotent `P * P = P` and ANY `A, C, X : B`:
1. **Mandelbrot Reformulation of `δ(X)` and Second-Iterate Expansion `δ(δ(X))`:**
   - `idemDefect X = mandelbrotStep (-X) X` and `idemDefectBar X = mandelbrotStep X X`,
   - `idemDefect (idemDefect X) = (X * X - X) * (X * X - X - 1)`,
   - Under the Mandelbrot seed shift `mandelbrotStep (-1) (idemDefect X) = (idemDefect X)² - 1`,
     on the Omega level set `idemDefect V = 1`, `idemDefect (idemDefect V) = 0` (the second iterate
     of `δ` on `V` lands on an exact idempotent fixed point `0`!).
2. **Two-Step Dyadic Defect Tower (`δ(-X²) * δ(-X) * δ(X) = δ(X⁴)`):**
   - `idemDefectBar X * idemDefect X = idemDefect (X * X)`,
   - `idemDefectBar (X * X) * idemDefectBar X * idemDefect X = idemDefect (X * X * X * X)`!
3. **Mandelbrot Iteration on the Tetraktys (`Φ ↦ V ↦ V²`):**
   - `mandelbrotStep (-genV P A C) (genPhi P A C) = 0` (`Φ` is a root of `Z² - V = 0`),
   - `mandelbrotStep (genV P A C) (genJ P A C) = 0` (`J` is a root of `Z² + V = 0`),

/-! ### Stage S₁: Dual Lie–Jordan Leibniz Laws, Jacobi Identities & Dyadic Defect Tower -/

name: stage_S1_leibniz_jacobi_and_dyadic_defect_tower
source_slice:
theorem stage_S1_leibniz_jacobi_and_dyadic_defect_tower (H U V X : B) :
    comm H (U * V) = comm H U * V + U * comm H V ∧
    comm H (U * V) = anticomm H U * V - U * anticomm H V ∧
    comm H (comm U V) + comm U (comm V H) + comm V (comm H U) = 0 ∧
    comm H (anticomm U V) - anticomm U (comm H V) = anticomm (comm H U) V ∧
    comm H (anticomm H U) = comm (H * H) U ∧
    idemDefect (1 - X) = idemDefect X ∧
    idemDefectBar X * idemDefect X = idemDefect (X * X) ∧
    idemDefectBar (X * X) * idemDefectBar X * idemDefect X =
      idemDefect ((X * X) * (X * X)) ∧
    (1 - X) * (1 + X) * (1 + X * X) * (1 + (X * X) * (X * X)) =
      1 - ((X * X) * (X * X)) * ((X * X) * (X * X)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    (simp only [idemDefect, idemDefectBar, comm, anticomm,
                sub_neg_eq_add, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg,
                add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one, mul_assoc]; abel)

theorem stage_S2_peirce_cartan_grading_and_tangent_closure
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    invS P * invS P = 1 ∧
    peirce11 P X + peirce00 P X + conePlus P X + coneMinus P X = X ∧
    comm P (comm P A) = oddGrade P A ∧
    A - comm P (comm P A) = evenGrade P A ∧
    comm P (comm P (comm P A)) = comm P A ∧
    anticomm P (comm P A) = comm P A ∧
    comm P (comm P A * comm P C) = 0 ∧
    zornConj P X = evenGrade P X - oddGrade P X ∧
    zornConj P (zornConj P X) = X := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-! ### Stage S₃: Nilpotent Cones, Split-Quaternion `Cl_{1,1}` Tetraktys & `so(1,2)` Lie Closure -/

name: stage_S3_nilpotent_cones_tetraktys_and_so12_brackets
source_slice:
theorem stage_S3_nilpotent_cones_tetraktys_and_so12_brackets
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    conePlus P A * conePlus P A = 0 ∧
    coneMinus P C * coneMinus P C = 0 ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C = genV P A C ∧
    genJ P A C * genJ P A C = -genV P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C + genJ P A C * genJ P A C = 0 ∧
    genJ P A C * genPhi P A C = genSig P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genJ P A C = -genSig P A C ∧
    anticomm (genPhi P A C) (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    genSig P A C = invS P * genV P A C ∧
    genSig P A C * genSig P A C = genV P A C * genV P A C ∧
    comm (conePlus P A) (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    comm (coneMinus P C) (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    comm (genPhi P A C) (genJ P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • genSig P A C) ∧
    comm (genSig P A C) (genPhi P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C) ∧
    comm (genSig P A C) (genJ P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-! ### Stage S₄: Sandwich Complementarity, Double-Derivation Trinity & Superoperator Ladders -/

name: stage_S4_sandwich_trinity_and_superoperator_ladders
source_slice:
theorem stage_S4_sandwich_trinity_and_superoperator_ladders
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    sandwichCross P A C X + sandwichSame P A C X = genPhi P A C * X * genPhi P A C ∧
    sandwichCross P A C X - sandwichSame P A C X = -(genJ P A C * X * genJ P A C) ∧
    (2 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • sandwichCross P A C X - anticomm (genV P A C) X) =
      derivSqPhi P A C X + derivSqJ P A C X ∧
    derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqJ P A C X = (4 : ℤ) • sandwichSame P A C X ∧
    ladderMinus P A C (genPhi P A C) = -((4 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C)) ∧
    ladderMinus P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    ladderPlus P A C (genJ P A C) = (4 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C) ∧
    ladderPlus P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    ladderMinus P A C X - ladderPlus P A C X = -((2 : ℤ) • comm (genSig P A C) X) ∧
    ladderSum P A C (ladderSum P A C (genPhi P A C)) =
      -((16 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genPhi P A C)) ∧
    ladderSum P A C (ladderSum P A C (genJ P A C)) =
      -((16 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genJ P A C)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

name: stage_S5_homogenized_projectors_and_second_order_orthogonality

theorem stage_S5_homogenized_projectors_and_second_order_orthogonality
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    hProjV P A C X + hProjPhi P A C X + hProjJ P A C X + hProjSig P A C X =
      (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * X) ∧
    hProjV P A C (genV P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genV P A C) ∧
    hProjV P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjV P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjV P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    idemDefect (goldenOp P A C) = genV P A C ∧
    idemDefect (goldenOpConj P A C) = genV P A C ∧
    idemDefect (goldenOpJ P A C) = -genV P A C ∧
    goldenOp P A C + goldenOpConj P A C = 1 ∧
    goldenOp P A C * goldenOpConj P A C = -genV P A C ∧
    goldenOp P A C * goldenOp P A C * goldenOp P A C =
      (1 + genV P A C) * goldenOp P A C + genV P A C ∧
    idemDefect (genPhi P A C) = genV P A C - genPhi P A C ∧
    idemDefect (-genPhi P A C) = genV P A C + genPhi P A C ∧
    galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genPhi P A C) = idemDefect (genV P A C) ∧
    galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genJ P A C) = idemDefectBar (genV P A C) ∧
    galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genPhi P A C) *
      galoisNormZorn P (genV P A C + genJ P A C) =
      idemDefect (genV P A C * genV P A C) ∧
    idemDefect (idemDefect (goldenOp P A C)) =
      idemDefect (qgtPlus P A C) + idemDefect (qgtMinus P A C) ∧
    idemDefect (idemDefect (genV P A C)) =
      idemDefect (idemDefect (qgtPlus P A C)) +
      idemDefect (idemDefect (qgtMinus P A C)) := by

theorem stage_S11_euler_zeta_mangoldt_and_legendre_partition
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    (P - idemTrans P A) * (idemTransv P C - P) = qgtPlus P A C ∧
    (idemTransv P C - P) * (P - idemTrans P A) = qgtMinus P A C ∧
    legendrePrimalPlus P A C * legendreDualPlus P A C = zetaSum1 P A C ∧
    legendreDualPlus P A C * legendrePrimalPlus P A C = zetaSum1 P A C ∧
    legendrePrimalMinus P A C * legendreDualMinus P A C = eulerInv P A C ∧
    legendreDualMinus P A C * legendrePrimalMinus P A C = eulerInv P A C ∧
    eulerInv P A C = (1 - genPhi P A C) * (1 + genPhi P A C) ∧
    eulerInv P A C * zetaSum1 P A C =
      eulerInv P A C - idemDefect (genV P A C) ∧
    eulerInv P A C * zetaSum2 P A C - 1 =
      -((1 + genV P A C) * idemDefect (genV P A C)) ∧
    eulerInv P A C * mangoldt2 P A C =
      -((1 + genV P A C) * idemDefect (genV P A C)) ∧
    legendrePrimalMinus P A C * legendreDualMinus P A C *
      legendrePrimalPlus P A C * legendreDualPlus P A C =
      eulerInv P A C - idemDefect (genV P A C) := by

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    cyclo6 X = idemDefect X + 1 ∧
    cyclo3 X = idemDefectBar X + 1 ∧
    cyclo1 X * cyclo2 X * cyclo3 X * cyclo6 X =
      (X * X * X) * (X * X * X) - 1 ∧
    cyclo4 (genJ P A C) = eulerInv P A C ∧
    cyclo4 (genPhi P A C) = zetaSum1 P A C ∧
    cyclo3 (genJ P A C) = weylJ P A C ∧
    cyclo6 (genJ P A C) = weylJInv P A C ∧
    cyclo3 (genJ P A C) * cyclo6 (genJ P A C) = cyclo6 (genV P A C) ∧
    cyclo3 (genPhi P A C) * cyclo6 (genPhi P A C) = zetaSum2 P A C ∧
    cyclo6 (goldenOp P A C) = zetaSum1 P A C ∧
    cyclo6 (goldenOpJ P A C) = eulerInv P A C ∧
    cyclo6 (goldenOpJ P A C) * cyclo6 (goldenOp P A C) =
      1 - genV P A C * genV P A C ∧
    idemDefect (idemDefect (goldenOp P A C)) *
      idemDefect (idemDefect (goldenOpJ P A C)) =
      idemDefect (genV P A C * genV P A C) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-- **Theorem A₄₅.1 (The Non-Commutative Bogoliubov–BCS / Nambu–Jona-Lasinio Gap Identity):**
For ANY idempotent `P * P = P` and ANY `A, C : B`:
1. **Exact Anticommutativity of the Bare Chiral Grading `S_P` and the Condensate `(Φ, J)`:**
   `anticomm (invS P) (genPhi P A C) = 0` and `anticomm (invS P) (genJ P A C) = 0`.
2. **The Euclidean Bogoliubov–NJL Dispersion Law (`H_NJL² = (S_P ± Φ)² = 1 + V = (1 + Q_+)(1 + Q_-)`):**
   - `nambuBogoliubov P A C * nambuBogoliubov P A C = 1 + genV P A C` (`= zetaSum1 P A C`),
   - `nambuBogoliubovConj P A C * nambuBogoliubovConj P A C = 1 + genV P A C`,
   - `nambuBogoliubov P A C * nambuBogoliubovConj P A C = 1 - genV P A C - (2 : ℤ) • genJ P A C`,
   - `anticomm (nambuBogoliubov P A C) (nambuBogoliubovConj P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (1 - genV P A C)`!
3. **The Lorentzian Bogoliubov–NJL Dispersion Law (`H̃_NJL² = (S_P ± J)² = 1 - V = (1 - Q_+)(1 - Q_-)`):**
   - `nambuBogoliubovJ P A C * nambuBogoliubovJ P A C = 1 - genV P A C` (`= eulerInv P A C`),
   - `nambuBogoliubovJConj P A C * nambuBogoliubovJConj P A C = 1 - genV P A C`,
   - `anticomm (nambuBogoliubovJ P A C) (nambuBogoliubovJConj P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (1 + genV P A C)`!
4. **Product of Euclidean and Lorentzian Bogoliubov Squares (`H_NJL² * H̃_NJL² = 1 - V²`):**
   `(nambuBogoliubov P A C * nambuBogoliubov P A C) * (nambuBogoliubovJ P A C * nambuBogoliubovJ P A C) =`
   `1 - genV P A C * genV P A C`! -/

      (2 : ℤ) • eulerInv P A C ∧

    nambuBogoliubovJ P A C * nambuBogoliubovJ P A C = eulerInv P A C ∧
    nambuBogoliubovJConj P A C * nambuBogoliubovJConj P A C = eulerInv P A C ∧
    nambuBogoliubovJ P A C * nambuBogoliubovJ P A C =

    anticomm (nambuBogoliubovJ P A C) (nambuBogoliubovJConj P A C) =

    superDerivMinus P_inf C_inf_op (superDerivMinus P_inf C_inf_op X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivPlusBar P_inf A_inf_op (superDerivPlusBar P_inf A_inf_op X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivMinusBar P_inf C_inf_op (superDerivMinusBar P_inf C_inf_op X) = 0 ∧
    -- 3. Colimit Hodge–Dirac Laplacians on `A_inf`:
    hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op X = (2 : ℤ) • (V_inf * X) ∧
    hodgeLaplacianSig P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op X = (2 : ℤ) • (Σ_inf * X) ∧
    superDerivPlus P_inf A_inf_op (superDerivMinusBar P_inf C_inf_op X) +
      superDerivPlusBar P_inf A_inf_op (superDerivMinus P_inf C_inf_op X) =
      (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op * X) ∧
    -- 4. Colimit De Rham Cochain Complex (`S_inf ──► Φ_inf, J_inf ──► V_inf, Σ_inf ──► 0`):
    superDerivPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (invS P_inf) = -((2 : ℤ) • J_inf) ∧
    superDerivPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Φ_inf = (2 : ℤ) • V_inf ∧
    superDerivJBar P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Φ_inf = (2 : ℤ) • Σ_inf ∧
    superDerivPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op V_inf = 0 ∧
    superDerivPhiBar P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Σ_inf = 0 := by
  intro ψ_m ι_km ι_k P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op V_inf Σ_inf Φ_inf J_inf
  have hP_inf : P_inf * P_inf = P_inf := by
    dsimp [P_inf, ι_k]; rw [← map_mul, hP_k]
  have hCocycle : ∀ m' : ℕ, ∀ x : A k,
      (Cone.toColimit (k + m')).toRingHom ((stepHomIter Cone k m').toRingHom x) =

    intro m'
    induction m' with
    | zero => intro x; rfl
    | succ m' ih =>

    ⟨_, _, _, hProjPhi_m, _, _, _, _, hLap_m⟩

      (Cone.toColimit k) P_k A_k C_k X_k with
    ⟨_, _, _, hProjPhi_k, _, _, _, _, hLap_k⟩

  have hRG_Lap :

      _ = ι_k (hodgeLaplacianPhi P_k A_k C_k X_k) := hCocycle m _

  refine ⟨hRG_Proj, hRG_Lap, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>

theorem colimit_steinberg_braids_and_weyl_covariant_projectors_lift
    {A : ℕ → Type*} [∀ k, Ring (A k)] [∀ k, StarRing (A k)]
    {A_inf : Type*} [Ring A_inf] [StarRing A_inf]
    (Cone : InductiveStarColimitCone A A_inf)
    (k : ℕ) (P_k A_k C_k : A k) (hP_k : P_k * P_k = P_k) (X : A_inf) :
    let ι_k := (Cone.toColimit k).toRingHom
    let P_inf := ι_k P_k
    let A_inf_op := ι_k A_k
    let C_inf_op := ι_k C_k
    let V_inf := genV P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
    let Φ_inf := genPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
    let J_inf := genJ P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
    steinbergBraid P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op *
      steinbergBraidInv P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op = 1 ∧
    steinbergBraidDual P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op *
      steinbergBraidDualInv P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op = 1 ∧
    steinbergBraid P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op -
      steinbergBraidDual P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op =
      (1 - V_inf) * Φ_inf ∧
    hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
      (hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Φ_inf) =
      (8 : ℤ) • ((V_inf * V_inf) * hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Φ_inf) ∧
    hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
      (hProjJ P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op J_inf) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (J_inf * X * (-J_inf)) =
      J_inf * hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op X * (-J_inf) ∧
    hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (Φ_inf * X * Φ_inf) =
      Φ_inf * hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op X * Φ_inf := by
  intro ι_k P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op V_inf Φ_inf J_inf
  have hP_inf : P_inf * P_inf = P_inf := by
    dsimp [P_inf, ι_k]; rw [← map_mul, hP_k]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    (dsimp [V_inf, Φ_inf, J_inf]; peirce_abel_unified hP_inf)

theorem colimit_orthogonal_channel_qgt_and_hodge_laplacian_additivity
    {p : R} (hp : p * p = p) {k₁ k₂ : ℕ} (hne : k₁ ≠ k₂) (a₁ c₁ a₂ c₂ : R)
    (X : TowerColimit R) :
    let P_inf := colimitVacuum p
    let A₁ := colimitChannel k₁ a₁
    let C₁ := colimitChannel k₁ c₁
    let A₂ := colimitChannel k₂ a₂
    let C₂ := colimitChannel k₂ c₂
    qgtPlus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      qgtPlus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtPlus P_inf A₂ C₂ ∧
    qgtMinus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      qgtMinus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtMinus P_inf A₂ C₂ ∧
    hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) X =
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A₁ C₁ X + hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A₂ C₂ X := by
  intro P_inf A₁ C₁ A₂ C₂
  have hP_inf : P_inf * P_inf = P_inf := colimitVacuum_idempotent hp
  have h12 : conePlus P_inf A₁ * coneMinus P_inf C₂ = 0 := by
    change conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ a₁) *
           coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ c₂) = 0
    rw [conePlus_colimitChannel, coneMinus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne _ _
  have h21 : conePlus P_inf A₂ * coneMinus P_inf C₁ = 0 := by
    change conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ a₂) *
           coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ c₁) = 0
    rw [conePlus_colimitChannel, coneMinus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne.symm _ _
  have h12' : coneMinus P_inf C₁ * conePlus P_inf A₂ = 0 := by
    change coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ c₁) *
           conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ a₂) = 0
    rw [coneMinus_colimitChannel, conePlus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne _ _
  have h21' : coneMinus P_inf C₂ * conePlus P_inf A₁ = 0 := by
    change coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ c₂) *
           conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ a₁) = 0
    rw [coneMinus_colimitChannel, conePlus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne.symm _ _
  have hPlusAdd : conePlus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) = conePlus P_inf A₁ + conePlus P_inf A₂ := by
    unfold conePlus; simp only [mul_add, add_mul]
  have hMinusAdd : coneMinus P_inf (C₁ + C₂) = coneMinus P_inf C₁ + coneMinus P_inf C₂ := by
    unfold coneMinus; simp only [mul_add, add_mul]
  have hQPlus : qgtPlus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      qgtPlus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtPlus P_inf A₂ C₂ := by
    unfold qgtPlus
    rw [hPlusAdd, hMinusAdd]
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, h12, h21]
    abel
  have hQMinus : qgtMinus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      qgtMinus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtMinus P_inf A₂ C₂ := by
    unfold qgtMinus
    rw [hPlusAdd, hMinusAdd]
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, h12', h21']
    abel
  have hVAdd : genV P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      genV P_inf A₁ C₁ + genV P_inf A₂ C₂ := by
    change qgtPlus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) + qgtMinus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
           (qgtPlus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtMinus P_inf A₁ C₁) +
           (qgtPlus P_inf A₂ C₂ + qgtMinus P_inf A₂ C₂)
    rw [hQPlus, hQMinus]; abel
  have hLapId : ∀ U W : TowerColimit R,
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf U W X = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P_inf U W * X) := by
    intro U W; peirce_abel_unified hP_inf
  refine ⟨hQPlus, hQMinus, ?_⟩
  rw [hLapId (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂), hLapId A₁ C₁, hLapId A₂ C₂,
      hVAdd, add_mul, smul_add]

theorem cone_sheet_braiding_all_scales
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let N_p := conePlus P_k A
    let N_m := coneMinus P_k C
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
    N_p * X_n = 0 ∧
    Y_n * N_p = 0 ∧
    N_m * Y_n = 0 ∧
    X_n * N_m = 0 ∧
    N_p * Y_n = X_n * N_p ∧
    N_m * X_n = Y_n * N_m := by
  intro P_k N_p N_m X_n Y_n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1
  dsimp [X_n, Y_n, N_p, N_m]
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    dsimp [mandelbrotTower]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_golay hPk
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    dsimp [mandelbrotTower]
    exact idemDefect_cone_sheet_braiding h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6

theorem archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    comm (conePlus P_k A) V_kn = 0 ∧
    comm (coneMinus P_k C) V_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24Gp1 P_k A C V_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24Gm1 P_k A C V_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24Gp2 P_k A C V_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24Gm2 P_k A C V_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24G0 P_k A C V_kn = (24 : ℤ) • (V_k * V_kn) ∧
    anticomm (conePlus P_k A) Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    anticomm (coneMinus P_k C) Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    anticomm (genPhi P_k A C) Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    anticomm (genJ P_k A C) Sig_kn = 0 := by
  intro P_k V_k V_kn Sig_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C) + mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C) :=
    hQuad.2.1
  rcases cone_sheet_braiding_all_scales hP A C k n with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  set X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
  set Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
  have hNpSq : N_p * N_p = 0 := by dsimp [N_p]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNmSq : N_m * N_m = 0 := by dsimp [N_m]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNpV : N_p * V_kn = V_kn * N_p := by
    rw [hSplit]
    calc N_p * (X_n + Y_n)
      _ = N_p * X_n + N_p * Y_n := by rw [mul_add]
      _ = 0 + X_n * N_p := by rw [h1, h5]
      _ = X_n * N_p + 0 := by abel
      _ = X_n * N_p + Y_n * N_p := by rw [h2]
      _ = (X_n + Y_n) * N_p := by rw [add_mul]
  have hNmV : N_m * V_kn = V_kn * N_m := by
    rw [hSplit]
    calc N_m * (X_n + Y_n)
      _ = N_m * X_n + N_m * Y_n := by rw [mul_add]
      _ = Y_n * N_m + 0 := by rw [h6, h3]
      _ = 0 + Y_n * N_m := by abel
      _ = X_n * N_m + Y_n * N_m := by rw [h4]
      _ = (X_n + Y_n) * N_m := by rw [add_mul]
  have hCommNp : comm N_p V_kn = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hNpV
  have hCommNm : comm N_m V_kn = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hNmV
  have hGp1 : kantorGp1 P_k A V_kn = 0 := hCommNp
  have hGm1 : kantorGm1 P_k C V_kn = 0 := hCommNm
  have hGp2 : kantorGp2 P_k A V_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGp2; change (N_p * V_kn) * N_p = 0
    rw [hNpV, mul_assoc, hNpSq, mul_zero]
  have hGm2 : kantorGm2 P_k C V_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGm2; change (N_m * V_kn) * N_m = 0
    rw [hNmV, mul_assoc, hNmSq, mul_zero]
  -- Audited direct `calc` proof of `hG0` without redundant pre-`rw`:
  have hG0 : kantorG0 P_k A C V_kn = V_k * V_kn := by
    unfold kantorG0 kantorTriple
    change (N_p * V_kn) * N_m + (N_m * V_kn) * N_p = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn
    calc (N_p * V_kn) * N_m + (N_m * V_kn) * N_p
      _ = N_p * (V_kn * N_m) + N_m * (V_kn * N_p) := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * (N_m * V_kn) + N_m * (N_p * V_kn) := by rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]
      _ = (N_p * N_m) * V_kn + (N_m * N_p) * V_kn := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn := by rw [← add_mul]
  have hA61 := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C V_kn
  have hAntiNp : anticomm N_p Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold anticomm chiralFractalBranch
    change N_p * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_p = 0
    calc N_p * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_p
      _ = (N_p * X_n - N_p * Y_n) + (X_n * N_p - Y_n * N_p) := by rw [mul_sub, sub_mul]
      _ = (0 - X_n * N_p) + (X_n * N_p - 0) := by rw [h1, h5, h2]
      _ = 0 := by abel
  have hAntiNm : anticomm N_m Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold anticomm chiralFractalBranch
    change N_m * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_m = 0
    calc N_m * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_m
      _ = (N_m * X_n - N_m * Y_n) + (X_n * N_m - Y_n * N_m) := by rw [mul_sub, sub_mul]
      _ = (Y_n * N_m - 0) + (0 - Y_n * N_m) := by rw [h6, h3, h4]
      _ = 0 := by abel
  refine ⟨hCommNp, hCommNm, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hAntiNp, hAntiNm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGp1, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGm1, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGp2, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGm2, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.1, hG0]
  · calc anticomm (genPhi P_k A C) Sig_kn
      _ = anticomm N_p Sig_kn + anticomm N_m Sig_kn := by
        unfold anticomm genPhi; change (N_p + N_m) * Sig_kn + Sig_kn * (N_p + N_m) = _
        simp only [add_mul, mul_add]; abel
      _ = 0 := by rw [hAntiNp, hAntiNm, add_zero]
  · calc anticomm (genJ P_k A C) Sig_kn
      _ = anticomm N_p Sig_kn - anticomm N_m Sig_kn := by
        unfold anticomm genJ; change (N_p - N_m) * Sig_kn + Sig_kn * (N_p - N_m) = _
        simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub]; abel
      _ = 0 := by rw [hAntiNp, hAntiNm, sub_self]

theorem archetype_A67_all_scale_chiral_defect_leech_and_mog24_isolation
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    -- 1. Leech `W₂₄` Grade `±2` Vanishing and Grade `0` Eigenvalue `-24 V_k` on `Σ_{k, n}`:
    golay24Gp2 P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24Gm2 P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24G0 P_k A C Sig_kn = -((24 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) ∧
    -- 2. Double-Derivation Eigenvalues on `Σ_{k, n}`:
    derivSqPhi P_k A C Sig_kn = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) ∧
    derivSqJ P_k A C Sig_kn = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) ∧
    derivSqSig P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    -- 3. Pure `mog24Sig` Channel Isolation of `Σ_{k, n}`:
    hProjV P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    mog24Sig P_k A C Sig_kn = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn) := by
  intro P_k V_k Sig_kn
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1
  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hAntiNp, hAntiNm, hAntiPhi, hAntiJ⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  have hNpSq : N_p * N_p = 0 := by dsimp [N_p]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNmSq : N_m * N_m = 0 := by dsimp [N_m]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNpS : N_p * Sig_kn = -(Sig_kn * N_p) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hAntiNp
  have hNmS : N_m * Sig_kn = -(Sig_kn * N_m) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hAntiNm
  have hGp2 : kantorGp2 P_k A Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGp2; change (N_p * Sig_kn) * N_p = 0
    rw [hNpS, neg_mul, mul_assoc, hNpSq, mul_zero, neg_zero]
  have hGm2 : kantorGm2 P_k C Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGm2; change (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_m = 0
    rw [hNmS, neg_mul, mul_assoc, hNmSq, mul_zero, neg_zero]
  -- Also prove that `V_k` and `Σ_k` commute with `Sig_kn`:
  have hVSig_comm : V_k * Sig_kn = Sig_kn * V_k := by
    change (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn = Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)
    calc (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn
      _ = N_p * (N_m * Sig_kn) + N_m * (N_p * Sig_kn) := by rw [add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * -(Sig_kn * N_m) + N_m * -(Sig_kn * N_p) := by rw [hNmS, hNpS]
      _ = -((N_p * Sig_kn) * N_m) - (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_p := by
          simp only [mul_neg, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(-(Sig_kn * N_p) * N_m) - -(Sig_kn * N_m) * N_p := by rw [hNpS, hNmS]
      _ = Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) := by
          simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_add, mul_assoc]; abel
  have hSigSig_comm : comm (genSig P_k A C) Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold comm genSig
    change (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) = 0
    calc (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p)
      _ = N_p * (N_m * Sig_kn) - N_m * (N_p * Sig_kn) - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) := by
          rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * -(Sig_kn * N_m) - N_m * -(Sig_kn * N_p) - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) := by
          rw [hNmS, hNpS]
      _ = -((N_p * Sig_kn) * N_m) + (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_p - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) := by
          simp only [mul_neg, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(-(Sig_kn * N_p) * N_m) + -(Sig_kn * N_m) * N_p - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) := by
          rw [hNpS, hNmS]
      _ = 0 := by simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_sub, mul_assoc]; abel
  have hG0 : kantorG0 P_k A C Sig_kn = -(V_k * Sig_kn) := by
    unfold kantorG0 kantorTriple
    change (N_p * Sig_kn) * N_m + (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_p = -(V_k * Sig_kn)
    calc (N_p * Sig_kn) * N_m + (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_p
      _ = -(Sig_kn * N_p) * N_m + -(Sig_kn * N_m) * N_p := by rw [hNpS, hNmS]
      _ = -(Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)) := by
          simp only [neg_mul, mul_add, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(Sig_kn * V_k) := rfl
      _ = -(V_k * Sig_kn) := by rw [hVSig_comm]
  have hA61 := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C Sig_kn
  -- Evaluate `derivSqPhi`, `derivSqJ`, and `derivSqSig` on `Sig_kn`:
  have hPhiSq : genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C = V_k := by
    dsimp [V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hJSq : genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C = -V_k := by
    dsimp [V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hPhiS : Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C = -(genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn) :=
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hAntiPhi
  have hJS : Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C = -(genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn) :=
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hAntiJ
  have hM_Phi : derivSqPhi P_k A C Sig_kn = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) := by
    unfold derivSqPhi comm
    have hSand : genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C = -(V_k * Sig_kn) := by
      calc genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C
        _ = genPhi P_k A C * (Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C) := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = genPhi P_k A C * -(genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn) := by rw [hPhiS]
        _ = -((genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C) * Sig_kn) := by simp only [mul_neg, mul_assoc]
        _ = -(V_k * Sig_kn) := by rw [hPhiSq]
    calc -(genPhi P_k A C * (genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C) -
           (genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C) * genPhi P_k A C)
      _ = -((genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C) * Sig_kn -
            genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C -
            genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C +
            Sig_kn * (genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C)) := by
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(V_k * Sig_kn - -(V_k * Sig_kn) - -(V_k * Sig_kn) + V_k * Sig_kn) := by
          rw [hPhiSq, hSand, ← hVSig_comm]
      _ = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) := by abel
  have hM_J : derivSqJ P_k A C Sig_kn = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) := by
    unfold derivSqJ comm
    have hSand : genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C = V_k * Sig_kn := by
      calc genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C
        _ = genJ P_k A C * (Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C) := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = genJ P_k A C * -(genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn) := by rw [hJS]
        _ = -((genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C) * Sig_kn) := by simp only [mul_neg, mul_assoc]
        _ = -((-V_k) * Sig_kn) := by rw [hJSq]
        _ = V_k * Sig_kn := by simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg]
    calc genJ P_k A C * (genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C) -
         (genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C) * genJ P_k A C
      _ = (genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C) * Sig_kn -
          genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C -
          genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C +
          Sig_kn * (genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C) := by
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = (-V_k) * Sig_kn - V_k * Sig_kn - V_k * Sig_kn + Sig_kn * (-V_k) := by
          rw [hJSq, hSand]
      _ = -(V_k * Sig_kn) - V_k * Sig_kn - V_k * Sig_kn - V_k * Sig_kn := by
          simp only [neg_mul, mul_neg, ← hVSig_comm]; abel
      _ = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) := by abel
  have hM_Sig : derivSqSig P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold derivSqSig; rw [hSigSig_comm]; unfold comm; rw [mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_self, neg_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hM_Phi, hM_J, hM_Sig, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGp2, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGm2, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.1, hG0, smul_neg]
  · unfold hProjV
    rw [hM_Phi, hM_J, hM_Sig, mul_neg, mul_neg, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
    abel
  · unfold hProjPhi
    rw [hM_Phi, hM_J, hM_Sig, sub_self, sub_zero]
  · unfold hProjJ
    rw [hM_J, hM_Phi, hM_Sig, sub_self, sub_zero]
  · unfold mog24Sig hProjSig
    rw [hM_Sig, hM_Phi, hM_J, mul_neg, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
    change (3 : ℤ) • (0 - -((4 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)) -
                         -((4 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn))) =
           (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)
    have h8 : (0 : B) - -((4 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)) -
                        -((4 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)) =
              (8 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn) := by abel
    rw [h8, smul_smul]
    rfl

/-- **Theorem A₆₈.1 (The Forward–Backward Wave Diffusion vs. Focusing Soliton Balance Theorem):**

let `P_k = daughterIdemTower k P A`, `V_k = genV P_k A C`, and `V_kn = mandelbrotTower n V_k`.
Then:
1. **Fundamental Decomposition into Diffusion ± Focusing:**
   - `derivSqPhi P A C X = diffusionOp P A C X + (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X`,
   - `derivSqJ P A C X   = diffusionOp P A C X - (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X`.
2. **Action of Pure Diffusion (`-2 V` on Both `Φ` and `J`) vs. Phase-Conjugate Focusing (`+V` on `Φ`, `-V` on `J`):**

   - `diffusionOp P A C (genJ P A C)   = -((2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C))`,
   - `focusingOp P A C (genPhi P A C)  = +(genV P A C * genPhi P A C)` (Constructive Focusing!),
   - `focusingOp P A C (genJ P A C)    = -(genV P A C * genJ P A C)` (Destructive Defocusing!).
3. **All-Scale `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ` Fractal Wave Packet Focusing & Defocusing:**
   For the fractal-modulated in-phase wave `Φ_k * V_{k, n}` and out-of-phase wave `J_k * V_{k, n}`:

     `Φ_k * V_{k, n} = conePlus P_k A * mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C) +`

   - **Focusing Mirror Reflects `Φ_k * V_{k, n}` with `+V_k` and `J_k * V_{k, n}` with `-V_k`:**
     `focusingOp P_k A C (genPhi P_k A C * V_kn) = V_k * genPhi P_k A C * V_kn` and

theorem archetype_A68_forward_backward_diffusion_vs_focusing_soliton_balance
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Φ_k := genPhi P_k A C
    let J_k := genJ P_k A C
    -- 1. Universal Decomposition `M_Φ = Diffusion + 2 • Focusing`, `M_J = Diffusion - 2 • Focusing`:
    derivSqPhi P A C X = diffusionOp P A C X + (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X ∧
    derivSqJ P A C X   = diffusionOp P A C X - (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X ∧
    -- 2. Single-Scale Diffusion (`-2 V`) vs. Focusing (`±V`):
    diffusionOp P A C (genPhi P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C)) ∧
    diffusionOp P A C (genJ P A C)   = -((2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C)) ∧
    focusingOp P A C (genPhi P A C)  = genV P A C * genPhi P A C ∧
    focusingOp P A C (genJ P A C)    = -(genV P A C * genJ P A C) ∧
    -- 3. All-Scale `(k, n)` Fractal Wavepacket Focusing (`M_Φ(Φ_k V_{k,n}) = 0`) vs. Defocusing (`-4 V_k`):
    focusingOp P_k A C (Φ_k * V_kn) = V_k * Φ_k * V_kn ∧
    focusingOp P_k A C (J_k * V_kn) = -(V_k * J_k * V_kn) ∧
    diffusionOp P_k A C (Φ_k * V_kn) = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * Φ_k * V_kn)) ∧
    diffusionOp P_k A C (J_k * V_kn) = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * J_k * V_kn)) ∧
    derivSqPhi P_k A C (Φ_k * V_kn) = 0 ∧
    derivSqPhi P_k A C (J_k * V_kn) = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * J_k * V_kn)) := by
  intro P_k V_k V_kn Φ_k J_k
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1
  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨hCommNp, hCommNm, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  have hNpV : N_p * V_kn = V_kn * N_p := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNp
  have hNmV : N_m * V_kn = V_kn * N_m := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNm
  -- Since `V_kn` commutes with `N_p` and `N_m`, it can be pulled to the far right of every operator!
  have hPullCross : ∀ Z : B,
      sandwichCross P_k A C (Z * V_kn) = sandwichCross P_k A C Z * V_kn := by
    intro Z; unfold sandwichCross
    change N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_m + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_p =
           (N_p * Z * N_m + N_m * Z * N_p) * V_kn
    calc N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_m + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_p
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (V_kn * N_m) + (N_m * Z) * (V_kn * N_p) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (N_m * V_kn) + (N_m * Z) * (N_p * V_kn) := by rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]
      _ = (N_p * Z * N_m + N_m * Z * N_p) * V_kn := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hPullSame : ∀ Z : B,
      focusingOp P_k A C (Z * V_kn) = focusingOp P_k A C Z * V_kn := by
    intro Z; unfold focusingOp sandwichSame
    change N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_p + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_m =
           (N_p * Z * N_p + N_m * Z * N_m) * V_kn
    calc N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_p + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_m
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (V_kn * N_p) + (N_m * Z) * (V_kn * N_m) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (N_p * V_kn) + (N_m * Z) * (N_m * V_kn) := by rw [← hNpV, ← hNmV]
      _ = (N_p * Z * N_p + N_m * Z * N_m) * V_kn := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hVk_Vkn : V_k * V_kn = V_kn * V_k := by
    change (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn = V_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)
    calc (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn
      _ = N_p * (N_m * V_kn) + N_m * (N_p * V_kn) := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * V_kn) * N_m + (N_m * V_kn) * N_p := by
          rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = V_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) := by
          rw [hNpV, hNmV]; simp only [mul_add, mul_assoc]
  have hPullDiff : ∀ Z : B,
      diffusionOp P_k A C (Z * V_kn) = diffusionOp P_k A C Z * V_kn := by
    intro Z; unfold diffusionOp anticomm
    rw [hPullCross Z]
    change (2 : ℤ) • (sandwichCross P_k A C Z * V_kn) - (V_k * (Z * V_kn) + (Z * V_kn) * V_k) =
           ((2 : ℤ) • sandwichCross P_k A C Z - (V_k * Z + Z * V_k)) * V_kn
    rw [mul_assoc Z V_kn V_k, ← hVk_Vkn]
    simp only [sub_mul, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  have hDecompPhi : ∀ Z : B,
      derivSqPhi P_k A C Z = diffusionOp P_k A C Z + (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P_k A C Z := by
    intro Z; unfold diffusionOp focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hFocPhi : focusingOp P_k A C Φ_k = V_k * Φ_k := by
    unfold focusingOp; dsimp [V_k, Φ_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hFocJ : focusingOp P_k A C J_k = -(V_k * J_k) := by
    unfold focusingOp; dsimp [V_k, J_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hDiffPhi : diffusionOp P_k A C Φ_k = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * Φ_k)) := by
    unfold diffusionOp; dsimp [V_k, Φ_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hDiffJ : diffusionOp P_k A C J_k = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * J_k)) := by
    unfold diffusionOp; dsimp [V_k, J_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  refine ⟨by unfold diffusionOp focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diffusionOp focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diffusionOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diffusionOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hPullSame Φ_k, hFocPhi]
  · rw [hPullSame J_k, hFocJ, neg_mul]
  · rw [hPullDiff Φ_k, hDiffPhi, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  · rw [hPullDiff J_k, hDiffJ, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  · rw [hDecompPhi (Φ_k * V_kn), hPullDiff Φ_k, hPullSame Φ_k,
        hDiffPhi, hFocPhi, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc, neg_add_cancel]
  · rw [hDecompPhi (J_k * V_kn), hPullDiff J_k, hPullSame J_k,
        hDiffJ, hFocJ, neg_mul, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_neg]
    abel

end CanonicalNonCommutativeMasterSpine

theorem archetype_A68_single_sheet_leech_swap_and_golay_12_24_projections
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let Sig_k := genSig P_k A C
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    -- 1. Chiral Parity Eigenvalues & Single-Sheet Annihilators:
    Sig_k * X_n = V_k * X_n ∧
    Sig_k * Y_n = -(V_k * Y_n) ∧
    (V_k - Sig_k) * X_n = 0 ∧
    (V_k + Sig_k) * Y_n = 0 ∧
    -- 2. All-Scale Leech `W₂₄^{(0)}` Mirror Sheet-Swapper (`X_n ↔ Y_n`):
    golay24G0 P_k A C X_n = (24 : ℤ) • (V_k * Y_n) ∧
    golay24G0 P_k A C Y_n = (24 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n) ∧
    -- 3. Scale-12 Half-Projections & Scale-24 Sheet Identity / Reflection on `X_n`:
    mog24V P_k A C X_n = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) ∧
    mog24Sig P_k A C X_n = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn) ∧
    mog24V P_k A C X_n + mog24Sig P_k A C X_n = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * X_n) ∧
    mog24V P_k A C X_n - mog24Sig P_k A C X_n = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Y_n) := by
  intro P_k V_k Sig_k X_n Y_n V_kn Sig_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = X_n + Y_n := hQuad.2.1
  rcases cone_sheet_braiding_all_scales hP A C k n with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  -- 1. Chiral Parity Eigenvalues `Sig_k * X_n = V_k * X_n` and `Sig_k * Y_n = -(V_k * Y_n)`:
  have hSig_X : Sig_k * X_n = V_k * X_n := by
    change (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * X_n = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * X_n
    calc (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * X_n
      _ = N_p * (N_m * X_n) - N_m * (N_p * X_n) := by simp only [sub_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * (N_m * X_n) + N_m * (N_p * X_n) := by rw [h1, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero]
      _ = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * X_n := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hSig_Y : Sig_k * Y_n = -(V_k * Y_n) := by
    change (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * Y_n = -((N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Y_n)
    calc (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * Y_n
      _ = N_p * (N_m * Y_n) - N_m * (N_p * Y_n) := by simp only [sub_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = -(N_p * (N_m * Y_n) + N_m * (N_p * Y_n)) := by rw [h3, mul_zero, zero_sub, zero_add]
      _ = -((N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Y_n) := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hAnn_X : (V_k - Sig_k) * X_n = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, hSig_X, sub_self]
  have hAnn_Y : (V_k + Sig_k) * Y_n = 0 := by rw [add_mul, hSig_Y, add_neg_cancel]
  -- 2. Grade-0 Kantor & Leech Mirror Sheet-Swap `X_n ↔ Y_n`:
  have hG0_X : kantorG0 P_k A C X_n = V_k * Y_n := by
    unfold kantorG0 kantorTriple
    change (N_p * X_n) * N_m + (N_m * X_n) * N_p = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Y_n
    calc (N_p * X_n) * N_m + (N_m * X_n) * N_p
      _ = 0 * N_m + N_m * (X_n * N_p) := by rw [h1, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * (N_m * Y_n) + N_m * (N_p * Y_n) := by rw [zero_mul, h3, mul_zero, ← h5]
      _ = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Y_n := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hG0_Y : kantorG0 P_k A C Y_n = V_k * X_n := by
    unfold kantorG0 kantorTriple
    change (N_p * Y_n) * N_m + (N_m * Y_n) * N_p = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * X_n
    calc (N_p * Y_n) * N_m + (N_m * Y_n) * N_p
      _ = N_p * (Y_n * N_m) + 0 * N_p := by rw [mul_assoc, h3]
      _ = N_p * (N_m * X_n) + N_m * (N_p * X_n) := by rw [zero_mul, h1, mul_zero, ← h6]
      _ = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * X_n := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hA61_X := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C X_n
  have hA61_Y := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C Y_n
  -- 3. Commutation of `V_k` and `Sig_k` with `X_n`, and `derivSq` on `X_n`:
  have hVX_comm : V_k * X_n = X_n * V_k := by
    change (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * X_n = X_n * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)
    calc (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * X_n
      _ = N_p * (N_m * X_n) + N_m * (N_p * X_n) := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * (Y_n * N_m) + 0 := by rw [h6, h1, mul_zero]
      _ = (N_p * Y_n) * N_m := by rw [add_zero, mul_assoc]
      _ = (X_n * N_p) * N_m + (X_n * N_m) * N_p := by rw [h5, h4, zero_mul, add_zero]
      _ = X_n * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) := by simp only [mul_add, mul_assoc]
  have hSigX_comm : comm Sig_k X_n = 0 := by
    unfold comm
    have hXSig : X_n * Sig_k = X_n * V_k := by
      change X_n * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) = X_n * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)
      calc X_n * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p)
        _ = (X_n * N_p) * N_m - (X_n * N_m) * N_p := by simp only [mul_sub, mul_assoc]
        _ = (X_n * N_p) * N_m + (X_n * N_m) * N_p := by rw [h4, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
        _ = X_n * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) := by simp only [mul_add, mul_assoc]
    rw [hSig_X, hXSig, hVX_comm, sub_self]
  have hPhiSq : genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C = V_k := by
    dsimp [V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hJSq : genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C = -V_k := by
    dsimp [V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hPhiXPhi : genPhi P_k A C * X_n * genPhi P_k A C = V_k * Y_n := by
    unfold genPhi
    change (N_p + N_m) * X_n * (N_p + N_m) = V_k * Y_n
    calc (N_p + N_m) * X_n * (N_p + N_m)
      _ = (N_p * X_n) * N_p + (N_p * X_n) * N_m + (N_m * X_n) * N_p + (N_m * X_n) * N_m := by
          simp only [add_mul, mul_add]
      _ = 0 + 0 + (N_m * X_n) * N_p + N_m * (X_n * N_m) := by
          rw [h1, zero_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * X_n) * N_m + (N_m * X_n) * N_p := by
          rw [h1, h4, zero_mul, mul_zero]; abel
      _ = V_k * Y_n := hG0_X
  have hJXJ : genJ P_k A C * X_n * genJ P_k A C = -(V_k * Y_n) := by
    unfold genJ
    change (N_p - N_m) * X_n * (N_p - N_m) = -(V_k * Y_n)
    calc (N_p - N_m) * X_n * (N_p - N_m)
      _ = (N_p * X_n) * N_p - (N_p * X_n) * N_m - (N_m * X_n) * N_p + (N_m * X_n) * N_m := by
          simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub]; abel
      _ = 0 - 0 - (N_m * X_n) * N_p + N_m * (X_n * N_m) := by
          rw [h1, zero_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = -((N_p * X_n) * N_m + (N_m * X_n) * N_p) := by
          rw [h1, h4, zero_mul, mul_zero]; abel
      _ = -(V_k * Y_n) := by rw [hG0_X]
  have hM_Phi : derivSqPhi P_k A C X_n = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n)) := by
    unfold derivSqPhi comm
    calc -(genPhi P_k A C * (genPhi P_k A C * X_n - X_n * genPhi P_k A C) -
           (genPhi P_k A C * X_n - X_n * genPhi P_k A C) * genPhi P_k A C)
      _ = -((genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C) * X_n -
            genPhi P_k A C * X_n * genPhi P_k A C -
            genPhi P_k A C * X_n * genPhi P_k A C +
            X_n * (genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C)) := by
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n - V_k * Y_n + V_k * X_n) := by
          rw [hPhiSq, hPhiXPhi, ← hVX_comm]
      _ = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n)) := by abel
  have hM_J : derivSqJ P_k A C X_n = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n)) := by
    unfold derivSqJ comm
    calc genJ P_k A C * (genJ P_k A C * X_n - X_n * genJ P_k A C) -
         (genJ P_k A C * X_n - X_n * genJ P_k A C) * genJ P_k A C
      _ = (genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C) * X_n -
          genJ P_k A C * X_n * genJ P_k A C -
          genJ P_k A C * X_n * genJ P_k A C +
          X_n * (genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C) := by

theorem archetype_A69_all_scale_quantum_erasure_decoder_and_sheet_separation
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let Sig_k := genSig P_k A C
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    -- 1. Chiral Parity Swap `Sig_k * Sig_kn = V_k * V_kn` and `Sig_k * V_kn = V_k * Sig_kn`:
    Sig_k * Sig_kn = V_k * V_kn ∧
    Sig_k * V_kn = V_k * Sig_kn ∧
    -- 2. Scale-12 Half-Projections on the Lower Sheet `Y_n`:
    mog24V P_k A C Y_n = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) ∧
    mog24Sig P_k A C Y_n = -((12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)) ∧
    -- 3. All-Scale Single-Sheet Erasure Recovery (`X_n ↦ 24 V_k³ V_{k,n}`, `Y_n ↦ 0` and Dual):
    mog24SheetPlus P_k A C X_n = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn) ∧
    mog24SheetPlus P_k A C Y_n = 0 ∧
    mog24SheetMinus P_k A C X_n = 0 ∧
    mog24SheetMinus P_k A C Y_n = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by
  intro P_k V_k Sig_k X_n Y_n V_kn Sig_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = X_n + Y_n := hQuad.2.1
  rcases archetype_A68_single_sheet_leech_swap_and_golay_12_24_projections hP A C k n with
    ⟨hSig_X, hSig_Y, _, _, _, _, hMogV_X, hMogSig_X, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A65_all_scale_fractal_codeword_error_immunity hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hMogV_V⟩
  rcases archetype_A67_all_scale_chiral_defect_leech_and_mog24_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hPV_S, _, _, hMogSig_S⟩
  have hMogSig_V : mog24Sig P_k A C V_kn = 0 := by
    unfold mog24Sig
    rw [(archetype_A65_all_scale_fractal_codeword_error_immunity hP A C k n).2.2.2.2.2.1,
        smul_zero]
  have hMogV_S : mog24V P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold mog24V; rw [hPV_S, smul_zero]
  -- 1. Chiral Swap `Sig_k * Sig_kn = V_k * V_kn` and `Sig_k * V_kn = V_k * Sig_kn`:
  have hSwap1 : Sig_k * Sig_kn = V_k * V_kn := by
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    change Sig_k * (X_n - Y_n) = V_k * V_kn
    rw [mul_sub, hSig_X, hSig_Y, sub_neg_eq_add, ← mul_add, ← hSplit]
  have hSwap2 : Sig_k * V_kn = V_k * Sig_kn := by
    rw [hSplit, mul_add, hSig_X, hSig_Y]
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    change V_k * X_n + -(V_k * Y_n) = V_k * (X_n - Y_n)
    rw [mul_sub, sub_eq_add_neg]
  -- 2. Linearity of `mog24V` and `mog24Sig` on `V_kn = X_n + Y_n` gives `mog24V Y_n` and `mog24Sig Y_n`:
  have hLinV : mog24V P_k A C (X_n + Y_n) = mog24V P_k A C X_n + mog24V P_k A C Y_n := by
    unfold mog24V hProjV derivSqPhi derivSqJ derivSqSig comm
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, sub_mul, mul_sub, neg_add_rev, smul_add]; abel
  have hLinSig : mog24Sig P_k A C (X_n + Y_n) = mog24Sig P_k A C X_n + mog24Sig P_k A C Y_n := by
    unfold mog24Sig hProjSig derivSqPhi derivSqJ derivSqSig comm
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, sub_mul, mul_sub, neg_add_rev, smul_add]; abel
  have hMogV_Y : mog24V P_k A C Y_n = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by
    have hSum := hMogV_V
    rw [hSplit, hLinV, hMogV_X] at hSum
    calc mog24V P_k A C Y_n
      _ = ((12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) + mog24V P_k A C Y_n) -
          (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by abel
      _ = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) - (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by rw [hSum]
      _ = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by rw [← sub_smul]; rfl
  have hMogSig_Y : mog24Sig P_k A C Y_n = -((12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)) := by
    have hSum := hMogSig_V
    rw [hSplit, hLinSig, hMogSig_X] at hSum
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hSum
  -- Also note `Sig_k * (V_k * V_k * Sig_kn) = (V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn` because `Sig_k` commutes with `V_k`:
  have hSigV_comm : Sig_k * V_k = V_k * Sig_k := by
    dsimp [Sig_k, V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hSigTriple : Sig_k * ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn) = (V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn := by
    calc Sig_k * ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)
      _ = (Sig_k * V_k) * V_k * Sig_kn := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = V_k * (Sig_k * V_k) * Sig_kn := by rw [hSigV_comm, mul_assoc]
      _ = (V_k * V_k) * (Sig_k * Sig_kn) := by rw [hSigV_comm]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn := by rw [hSwap1]; simp only [mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨hSwap1, hSwap2, hMogV_Y, hMogSig_Y, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold mog24SheetPlus
    change V_k * mog24V P_k A C X_n + Sig_k * mog24Sig P_k A C X_n = _
    rw [hMogV_X, hMogSig_X, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc V_k (V_k * V_k) V_kn,
        hSigTriple, ← add_smul]
    rfl
  · unfold mog24SheetPlus
    change V_k * mog24V P_k A C Y_n + Sig_k * mog24Sig P_k A C Y_n = 0
    rw [hMogV_Y, hMogSig_Y, mul_neg, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm,
        ← mul_assoc V_k (V_k * V_k) V_kn, hSigTriple, add_neg_cancel]
  · unfold mog24SheetMinus
    change V_k * mog24V P_k A C X_n - Sig_k * mog24Sig P_k A C X_n = 0
    rw [hMogV_X, hMogSig_X, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm,
        ← mul_assoc V_k (V_k * V_k) V_kn, hSigTriple, sub_self]
  · unfold mog24SheetMinus
    change V_k * mog24V P_k A C Y_n - Sig_k * mog24Sig P_k A C Y_n = _
    rw [hMogV_Y, hMogSig_Y, mul_neg, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm,
        ← mul_assoc V_k (V_k * V_k) V_kn, hSigTriple, sub_neg_eq_add, ← add_smul]
    rfl

theorem archetype_A70_impossible_future_retrocausal_handshake_and_all_scale_error_correction
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A

    (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn) = -((V_k * J_k) * (V_kn * V_kn * V_kn)) ∧

    mog24V P_k A C
      (V_kn + conjPlus P_k A (Φ_k * V_kn) + conjMinus P_k C (J_k * V_kn) + Sig_kn) =
      (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by
  intro P_k N_p N_m V_k Φ_k J_k V_kn Sig_kn
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1
  rcases archetype_A65_all_scale_fractal_codeword_error_immunity hP A C k n with
    ⟨hCommPhi, hCommJ, hCommSig, _, _, _, hMogV_Vkn⟩
  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨hCommNp, hCommNm, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  have hProjV_Sig : hProjV P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 :=
    (archetype_A67_all_scale_chiral_defect_leech_and_mog24_isolation hP A C k n).2.2.2.2.2.2.1

  have hNmSq : N_m * N_m = 0 := by dsimp [N_m]; peirce_abel_golay hPk

  have hImpFuture : (N_p * V_kn) * (N_p * V_kn) = 0 := by

      _ = (N_p * N_p) * (V_kn * V_kn) := by rw [← hNpV]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hNpSq, zero_mul]
  have hImpPast : (N_m * V_kn) * (N_m * V_kn) = 0 := by
    calc (N_m * V_kn) * (N_m * V_kn)

      _ = (N_m * N_m) * (V_kn * V_kn) := by rw [← hNmV]; simp only [mul_assoc]

      _ = N_p * (N_m * V_kn) + N_m * (N_p * V_kn) := by rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]

      _ = V_k * (V_kn * V_kn) := by rw [hPhiSq]
  have hCubicPhi :
      (Φ_k * V_kn) * (Φ_k * V_kn) * (Φ_k * V_kn) = (V_k * Φ_k) * (V_kn * V_kn * V_kn) := by
    calc (Φ_k * V_kn) * (Φ_k * V_kn) * (Φ_k * V_kn)

      _ = V_k * (V_kn * (V_kn * Φ_k)) * V_kn := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = V_k * (V_kn * (Φ_k * V_kn)) * V_kn := by rw [← hPhiV]
      _ = V_k * ((V_kn * Φ_k) * V_kn) * V_kn := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = V_k * ((Φ_k * V_kn) * V_kn) * V_kn := by rw [← hPhiV]
      _ = (V_k * Φ_k) * (V_kn * V_kn * V_kn) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hSqJ : (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn) = -(V_k * (V_kn * V_kn)) := by
    calc (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn)

      _ = (J_k * J_k) * (V_kn * V_kn) := by rw [← hJV]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = -(V_k * (V_kn * V_kn)) := by rw [hJSq, neg_mul]
  have hCubicJ :
      (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn) = -((V_k * J_k) * (V_kn * V_kn * V_kn)) := by
    calc (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn) * (J_k * V_kn)
      _ = -(V_k * (V_kn * V_kn)) * (J_k * V_kn) := by rw [hSqJ]
      _ = -(V_k * (V_kn * (V_kn * J_k)) * V_kn) := by simp only [neg_mul, mul_assoc]

lemma comm_mul_right_of_comm {G W : B} (hGW : comm G W = 0) (Z : B) :
    comm G (Z * W) = comm G Z * W := by
  have hEq : G * W = W * G := sub_eq_zero.mp hGW
  unfold comm
  calc G * (Z * W) - (Z * W) * G
    _ = (G * Z) * W - Z * (W * G) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = (G * Z) * W - Z * (G * W) := by rw [← hEq]
    _ = (G * Z - Z * G) * W       := by simp only [sub_mul, mul_assoc]
