theorem archetype_A75_multi_depth_cross_sheet_orthogonality_and_graded_codeword_algebra
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n m : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
    let X_m := mandelbrotTower m (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let Y_m := mandelbrotTower m (qgtMinus P_k A C)
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n (genV P_k A C)
    let V_km := mandelbrotTower m (genV P_k A C)
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    let Sig_km := chiralFractalBranch m P_k A C
    -- 1. Cross-Depth Sheet Orthogonality (`∀ n m : ℕ`):
    X_n * Y_m = 0 ∧
    Y_n * X_m = 0 ∧
    -- 2. Multi-Depth Graded Multiplication Table (`Σ_{k,n} * Σ_{k,m} = V_{k,n} * V_{k,m}`):
    V_kn * V_km = X_n * X_m + Y_n * Y_m ∧
    Sig_kn * Sig_km = V_kn * V_km ∧
    Sig_kn * V_km = X_n * X_m - Y_n * Y_m ∧
    V_kn * Sig_km = Sig_kn * V_km ∧
    -- 3. Multi-Depth Fault-Tolerant Invariance Under Bruhat and Steinberg Turbulence:
    moebiusConj P_k A C (Sig_kn * Sig_km) = V_kn * V_km ∧
    steinbergConj P_k A C (Sig_kn * Sig_km) = V_kn * V_km := by
  intro P_k X_n Y_n X_m Y_m V_kn V_km Sig_kn Sig_km
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1
  have hSplit_n : V_kn = X_n + Y_n :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n).2.1
  have hSplit_m : V_km = X_m + Y_m :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k m).2.1
  rcases archetype_A74_all_scale_fractal_instanton_self_duality_and_hodge_star_swap hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, hXn_R, _, hYn_R, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A72_andreev_multipass_mandelbrot_defect_and_all_scale_sheet_confinement hP A C k m with
    ⟨_, _, _, hQm_X, _, _, hPm_Y, _, _, _, _⟩
  -- 1. Prove `X_n * Y_m = 0` and `Y_n * X_m = 0` in 2 lines using `P_k` and `1 - P_k` absorption!
  have hXY_nm : X_n * Y_m = 0 := by
    calc X_n * Y_m
      _ = (X_n * P_k) * Y_m := by rw [hXn_R]
      _ = X_n * (P_k * Y_m) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hPm_Y, mul_zero]
  have hYX_nm : Y_n * X_m = 0 := by
    calc Y_n * X_m
      _ = (Y_n * (1 - P_k)) * X_m := by rw [hYn_R]
      _ = Y_n * ((1 - P_k) * X_m) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hQm_X, mul_zero]
  -- 2. Deduce the Multi-Depth Graded Multiplication Table:
  have hVV : V_kn * V_km = X_n * X_m + Y_n * Y_m := by
    rw [hSplit_n, hSplit_m]
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, hXY_nm, hYX_nm, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hSS : Sig_kn * Sig_km = V_kn * V_km := by
    rw [hVV]
    unfold Sig_kn Sig_km chiralFractalBranch
    change (X_n - Y_n) * (X_m - Y_m) = X_n * X_m + Y_n * Y_m
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, hXY_nm, hYX_nm, sub_zero, zero_sub, sub_neg_eq_add]
  have hSV : Sig_kn * V_km = X_n * X_m - Y_n * Y_m := by
    rw [hSplit_m]
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    change (X_n - Y_n) * (X_m + Y_m) = X_n * X_m - Y_n * Y_m
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_add, hXY_nm, hYX_nm, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hVS : V_kn * Sig_km = Sig_kn * V_km := by
    rw [hSV, hSplit_n]
    unfold Sig_km chiralFractalBranch
    change (X_n + Y_n) * (X_m - Y_m) = X_n * X_m - Y_n * Y_m
    simp only [add_mul, mul_sub, hXY_nm, hYX_nm, sub_zero, zero_sub, add_neg_eq_sub]
  -- 3. Fault-Tolerant Invariance of `Sig_kn * Sig_km = V_kn * V_km`:
  rcases archetype_A73_steinberg_yang_baxter_defect_chebyshev_trace_and_all_scale_invariance hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hMoeb_n, _, hStein_n, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A73_steinberg_yang_baxter_defect_chebyshev_trace_and_all_scale_invariance hP A C k m with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hMoeb_m, _, hStein_m, _, _⟩
  have hBruhat_inv : moebiusBruhatInv P_k A C * moebiusBruhat P_k A C = 1 := by
    peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hStein_inv : steinbergBraidInv P_k A C * steinbergBraid P_k A C = 1 := by
    peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hMoebMul : moebiusConj P_k A C (V_kn * V_km) =
      moebiusConj P_k A C V_kn * moebiusConj P_k A C V_km := by
    unfold moebiusConj
    calc moebiusBruhat P_k A C * (V_kn * V_km) * moebiusBruhatInv P_k A C
      _ = moebiusBruhat P_k A C * V_kn * 1 * V_km * moebiusBruhatInv P_k A C := by
          rw [mul_one]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = moebiusBruhat P_k A C * V_kn *
          (moebiusBruhatInv P_k A C * moebiusBruhat P_k A C) *
          V_km * moebiusBruhatInv P_k A C := by rw [hBruhat_inv]
      _ = (moebiusBruhat P_k A C * V_kn * moebiusBruhatInv P_k A C) *
          (moebiusBruhat P_k A C * V_km * moebiusBruhatInv P_k A C) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hSteinMul : steinbergConj P_k A C (V_kn * V_km) =
      steinbergConj P_k A C V_kn * steinbergConj P_k A C V_km := by
    unfold steinbergConj
    calc steinbergBraid P_k A C * (V_kn * V_km) * steinbergBraidInv P_k A C
      _ = steinbergBraid P_k A C * V_kn * 1 * V_km * steinbergBraidInv P_k A C := by
          rw [mul_one]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = steinbergBraid P_k A C * V_kn *
          (steinbergBraidInv P_k A C * steinbergBraid P_k A C) *
          V_km * steinbergBraidInv P_k A C := by rw [hStein_inv]
      _ = (steinbergBraid P_k A C * V_kn * steinbergBraidInv P_k A C) *
          (steinbergBraid P_k A C * V_km * steinbergBraidInv P_k A C) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨hXY_nm, hYX_nm, hVV, hSS, hSV, hVS, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hSS, hMoebMul, hMoeb_n, hMoeb_m]
  · rw [hSS, hSteinMul, hStein_n, hStein_m]

    -- 2. All-Scale Para-Complex Action & Madelung Vorticity Factorization:
    comm P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = J_k * V_kn ∧

    rw [comm_mul_right_of_comm hPhiV, comm_mul_right_of_comm hPhiV, neg_mul]
  have hPullMet : ∀ Z : B, metriplecticOp P_k A C (Z * V_kn) = metriplecticOp P_k A C Z * V_kn := by
    intro Z; unfold metriplecticOp
    rw [comm_mul_right_of_comm hSigV, hPullMPhi Z, add_mul]
  have hMPhi_Vkn : derivSqPhi P_k A C V_kn = 0 := by
    unfold derivSqPhi; rw [hCommPhi]; unfold comm; rw [mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_self, neg_zero]
  have hMet_Vkn : metriplecticOp P_k A C V_kn = 0 := by

  have hSigSig_comm : comm Sig_k Sig_kn = 0 := by
    rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with

    have hNmS : N_m * Sig_kn = -(Sig_kn * N_m) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hAntiNm

    calc (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p)

          rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

      (4 : ℤ) • (V_k * metriplecticOp P_k A C Sig_kn) = 0 := by

    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1

    intro Z; unfold metriplecticOp

  · rw [hPullMet J_k, hPullMet (metriplecticOp P_k A C J_k)]

           (4 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * J_k)) * V_kn := by
          simp only [sub_mul, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 * V_kn := by rw [hA74.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2]

  · -- For `Sig_kn = invS P_k * V_kn = (invS P_k * V_k ...)` or using `L_met(V_k * Sig_kn)`:

        metriplecticOp P_k A C (-((4 : ℤ) • Z)) = -((4 : ℤ) • metriplecticOp P_k A C Z) := by
      intro Z; unfold metriplecticOp derivSqPhi comm

      abel
    have hMetSig := hA75.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    rw [hMetSig, hMetLinearNeg4 (V_k * Sig_kn), hMetLeftVk Sig_kn, hMetSig]
    simp only [mul_neg, mul_smul_comm]

/-- **Theorem A₇₇.1 (Dirac Bra-Ket Ideal Synthesis & Dirac–Krein Adjoint Duality):**
Let `P : B` be a self-adjoint idempotent (`hP : P * P = P`, `hPsym : star P = P`) and let `A, X, Y : B`.
Then:
1. **Bra-Ket Involution & Outer/Inner Product Dictionary (`|ψ⟩⟨ψ| = Q_+`, `⟨ψ|ψ⟩ = Q_-`):**
   - `star (diracKet P A) = diracBra P A` and `star (diracBra P A) = diracKet P A`,
   - `diracKet P A * diracBra P A = qgtPlus P A (star A)` (`|ψ_A⟩⟨ψ_A| = Q_+`),
   - `diracBra P A * diracKet P A = qgtMinus P A (star A)` (`⟨ψ_A|ψ_A⟩ = Q_-`),
   - `diracKet P A * diracBra P A + diracBra P A * diracKet P A = genV P A (star A)`,
   - `diracKet P A * diracBra P A - diracBra P A * diracKet P A = genSig P A (star A)`!
2. **Dirac–Krein Adjoint Anti-Automorphism (`(X^#)^# = X`, `(X * Y)^# = Y^# * X^#`):**
   - `diracKreinAdj P (diracKreinAdj P X) = X`,
   - `diracKreinAdj P (X * Y) = diracKreinAdj P Y * diracKreinAdj P X`,
   - `diracKreinAdj P (diracKet P A) = -diracBra P A` (Negative Krein norm on off-diagonal kets!).
3. **Left-Ideal (`B * P`) vs. Right-Ideal (`P * B`) Absorption & Exact Krein Duality `(P_A)^# = P_{A⋆}`:**
   - Right-Ideal Generator `P_A = idemTrans P A`: `P * P_A = P_A` and `P_A * P = P`,
   - Left-Ideal Generator `P_{A⋆} = idemTransv P (star A)`: `P_{A⋆} * P = P_{A⋆}` and `P * P_{A⋆} = P`,
   - **Exact Dirac–Krein Ideal Duality:**
     `diracKreinAdj P (idemTrans P A) = idemTransv P (star A)`!
4. **Hermitian (`star`) vs. Dirac–Krein (`diracKreinAdj`) Self-Adjointness of the Tetraktys `(Φ, J, V, Σ)`:**
   For `C = star A`:
   - Hermitian `star`:
     `star (genPhi P A (star A)) = genPhi P A (star A)` (`Φ` is Hermitian),
     `star (genJ P A (star A))   = -genJ P A (star A)` (`J` is skew-Hermitian),
     `star (genV P A (star A))   = genV P A (star A)` (`V` is Hermitian),
     `star (genSig P A (star A)) = genSig P A (star A)` (`Σ` is Hermitian)!

     `diracKreinAdj P (genPhi P A (star A)) = -genPhi P A (star A)` (`Φ` is Krein-skew-adjoint),
     `diracKreinAdj P (genJ P A (star A))   = genJ P A (star A)` (`J` is Krein-self-adjoint!),
     `diracKreinAdj P (genV P A (star A))   = genV P A (star A)` (`V` is Krein-self-adjoint),

theorem archetype_A77_dirac_bra_ket_ideals_and_krein_conjugation_duality
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (hPsym : star P = P) (A X Y : B) :
    -- 1. Bra-Ket Dictionary (`star |ψ⟩ = ⟨ψ|`, `|ψ⟩⟨ψ| = Q_+`, `⟨ψ|ψ⟩ = Q_-`):
    star (diracKet P A) = diracBra P A ∧
    star (diracBra P A) = diracKet P A ∧
    diracKet P A * diracBra P A = qgtPlus P A (star A) ∧
    diracBra P A * diracKet P A = qgtMinus P A (star A) ∧
    diracKet P A * diracBra P A + diracBra P A * diracKet P A =
      genV P A (star A) ∧
    diracKet P A * diracBra P A - diracBra P A * diracKet P A =
      genSig P A (star A) ∧
    -- 2. Dirac–Krein Adjoint Involution & Anti-Automorphism:
    diracKreinAdj P (diracKreinAdj P X) = X ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (X * Y) = diracKreinAdj P Y * diracKreinAdj P X ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (diracKet P A) = -diracBra P A ∧
    -- 3. Left/Right Ideal Absorption & Exact Krein Ideal Duality `(idemTrans P A)^# = idemTransv P (star A)`:
    P * idemTrans P A = idemTrans P A ∧
    idemTrans P A * P = P ∧
    idemTransv P (star A) * P = idemTransv P (star A) ∧
    P * idemTransv P (star A) = P ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (idemTrans P A) = idemTransv P (star A) ∧
    -- 4. Complementary Hermitian (`star`) vs. Dirac–Krein (`diracKreinAdj`) Self-Adjointness:
    star (genPhi P A (star A)) = genPhi P A (star A) ∧
    star (genJ P A (star A)) = -genJ P A (star A) ∧
    star (genV P A (star A)) = genV P A (star A) ∧
    star (genSig P A (star A)) = genSig P A (star A) ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (genPhi P A (star A)) = -genPhi P A (star A) ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (genJ P A (star A)) = genJ P A (star A) ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (genV P A (star A)) = genV P A (star A) ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (genSig P A (star A)) = genSig P A (star A) := by
  have hStarS : star (invS P) = invS P := by
    unfold invS; rw [star_sub, star_sub, star_one, hPsym]
  have hSSq : invS P * invS P = 1 := by peirce_abel_golay hP
  have hKetStar : star (diracKet P A) = diracBra P A := by
    unfold diracKet diracBra conePlus coneMinus
    rw [star_mul, star_mul, star_sub, star_one, hPsym, mul_assoc]
  have hBraStar : star (diracBra P A) = diracKet P A := by
    rw [← hKetStar, star_star]
  have hStarPhi : star (genPhi P A (star A)) = genPhi P A (star A) := by
    change star (diracKet P A + diracBra P A) = diracKet P A + diracBra P A
    rw [star_add, hKetStar, hBraStar, add_comm]
  have hStarJ : star (genJ P A (star A)) = -genJ P A (star A) := by
    change star (diracKet P A - diracBra P A) = -(diracKet P A - diracBra P A)
    rw [star_sub, hKetStar, hBraStar, neg_sub]
  have hStarQPlus : star (qgtPlus P A (star A)) = qgtPlus P A (star A) := by
    change star (diracKet P A * diracBra P A) = diracKet P A * diracBra P A
    rw [star_mul, hBraStar, hKetStar]
  have hStarQMinus : star (qgtMinus P A (star A)) = qgtMinus P A (star A) := by
    change star (diracBra P A * diracKet P A) = diracBra P A * diracKet P A
    rw [star_mul, hKetStar, hBraStar]
  have hStarV : star (genV P A (star A)) = genV P A (star A) := by
    change star (qgtPlus P A (star A) + qgtMinus P A (star A)) =
           qgtPlus P A (star A) + qgtMinus P A (star A)
    rw [star_add, hStarQPlus, hStarQMinus]
  have hStarSig : star (genSig P A (star A)) = genSig P A (star A) := by
    change star (qgtPlus P A (star A) - qgtMinus P A (star A)) =
           qgtPlus P A (star A) - qgtMinus P A (star A)
    rw [star_sub, hStarQPlus, hStarQMinus]
  refine ⟨hKetStar, hBraStar, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
          hStarPhi, hStarJ, hStarV, hStarSig, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold diracKreinAdj
    rw [star_mul, star_mul, star_star, hStarS]
    calc invS P * (invS P * X * invS P) * invS P
      _ = (invS P * invS P) * X * (invS P * invS P) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 * X * 1 := by rw [hSSq]
      _ = X := by rw [one_mul, mul_one]
  · unfold diracKreinAdj
    rw [star_mul]
    calc invS P * (star Y * star X) * invS P
      _ = invS P * star Y * 1 * star X * invS P := by rw [mul_one]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = invS P * star Y * (invS P * invS P) * star X * invS P := by rw [hSSq]
      _ = (invS P * star Y * invS P) * (invS P * star X * invS P) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
  · unfold diracKreinAdj
    rw [hKetStar]; unfold diracBra; peirce_abel_golay hP
  · peirce_abel_golay hP
  · peirce_abel_golay hP
  · peirce_abel_golay hP
  · peirce_abel_golay hP
  · unfold diracKreinAdj
    have hIdemTrans : idemTrans P A = P - diracKet P A := by
      unfold diracKet; peirce_abel_golay hP
    rw [hIdemTrans, star_sub, hPsym, hKetStar]
    unfold diracBra; peirce_abel_golay hP
  · unfold diracKreinAdj; rw [hStarPhi]; peirce_abel_golay hP
  · unfold diracKreinAdj; rw [hStarJ]; peirce_abel_golay hP
  · unfold diracKreinAdj; rw [hStarV]; peirce_abel_golay hP

/-- **Theorem A₇₈.1 (Left/Right Ideal Bra-Ket Calculus, Born–Hua Fidelity & Dirac–Krein Spinor Norm):**
For ANY self-adjoint idempotent `P : B` (`hP : P * P = P`, `hPsym : star P = P`) and ANY `A, C, X, Y : B`:
1. **Exact Left-Ideal (`B P`) and Right-Ideal (`P B`) Decomposition & Inner Product Closure:**
   - Every left-ideal ket splits into Vacuum (`peirce11`) + Excited (`coneMinus`):
     `ketIdeal P X = peirce11 P X + coneMinus P X`,
   - Every right-ideal bra splits into Vacuum (`peirce11`) + Excited (`conePlus`):
     `braIdeal P Y = peirce11 P Y + conePlus P Y`,
   - The Bra-Ket inner product `⟨Φ_Y | Ψ_X⟩` closes strictly into `P B P`:
     `braIdeal P Y * ketIdeal P X = peirce11 P (Y * X)`,
   - Left multiplication by any `U : B` preserves the left ideal:
     `U * ketIdeal P X = ketIdeal P (U * X)`!
2. **Projective Bra-Ket Overlap of the Hua–Bertram Chart Idempotents `P_A ∈ P B` and `P_C ∈ B P`:**

theorem archetype_A82_all_scale_two_state_projective_sandwich_and_bruhat_rg_link
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let P_k1 := daughterIdemTower (k + 1) P A
    let P_Ck := idemTransv P_k C
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let Φ_k := genPhi P_k A C
    let J_k := genJ P_k A C
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    -- 1. All-Scale Möbius–Bruhat Link Between `P_{C, k}` and `P_{k+1}`:
    moebiusConj P_k A C P_Ck = P_k1 ∧
    moebiusConjDual P_k A C P_k1 = P_Ck ∧
    -- 2. All-Scale Two-State Projective Sandwich on `(Φ_k V_{k,n}, J_k V_{k,n}, V_{k,n}, Σ_{k,n})`:
    P_k1 * (Φ_k * V_kn) * P_Ck = 0 ∧
    P_k1 * (J_k * V_kn) * P_Ck = (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_k A C * X_n) ∧
    P_k1 * V_kn * P_Ck = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n ∧
    P_k1 * Sig_kn * P_Ck = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n := by
  intro P_k P_k1 P_Ck V_k Φ_k J_k X_n V_kn Sig_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = X_n + mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C) := hQuad.2.1
  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, hCommNm, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A72_andreev_multipass_mandelbrot_defect_and_all_scale_sheet_confinement hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hPY_L, _, _, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A74_all_scale_fractal_instanton_self_duality_and_hodge_star_swap hP A C k n with
    ⟨hPX_L, hPX_R, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  have hA80 := archetype_A80_all_scale_fractal_dirac_ideals_and_rg_chain_links hP A C k n
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  set Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
  have hNmV : N_m * V_kn = V_kn * N_m := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNm
  have hPkV : P_k * V_kn = V_kn * P_k := by
    rw [← hA80.2.2.2.2.2.1, ← hA80.2.2.2.2.1]
  -- `V_kn` commutes with `P_Ck = P_k + N_m`:
  have hVkn_PCk : V_kn * P_Ck = P_Ck * V_kn := by
    unfold P_Ck idemTransv
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, hPkV, hNmV]
  have hPVkn : P_k * V_kn = X_n := hA80.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hPSig : P_k * Sig_kn = X_n := by
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    rw [mul_sub, hPX_L, hPY_L, sub_zero]
  have hSigP : Sig_kn * P_k = X_n := by
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    have hYP_R : Y_n * P_k = 0 :=
      (archetype_A72_andreev_multipass_mandelbrot_defect_and_all_scale_sheet_confinement
        hP A C k n).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    rw [sub_mul, hPX_R, hYP_R, sub_zero]
  have hPCk_eq : P_Ck * P_k = P_Ck := by
    unfold P_Ck idemTransv; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hPk1_eq : P_k1 * P_k = P_k := hA80.2.1
  have hPk1_PCk : P_k1 * P_Ck = eulerInv P_k A C * P_k := by
    dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, P_Ck, V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hBasePhi : P_k1 * Φ_k * P_Ck = 0 := by
    dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, Φ_k, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hBaseJ : P_k1 * J_k * P_Ck = (2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P_k A C := by
    dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, J_k, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hQgt_P : qgtPlus P_k A C * P_k = qgtPlus P_k A C := by
    peirce_abel_golay hPk
  refine ⟨by dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          by unfold moebiusConjDual moebiusBruhatDual moebiusBruhatDualInv
             dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc P_k1 * (Φ_k * V_kn) * P_Ck
      _ = P_k1 * Φ_k * (V_kn * P_Ck) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k1 * Φ_k * P_Ck) * V_kn := by rw [hVkn_PCk]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hBasePhi, zero_mul]
  · calc P_k1 * (J_k * V_kn) * P_Ck
      _ = P_k1 * J_k * (V_kn * P_Ck) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k1 * J_k * P_Ck) * V_kn := by rw [hVkn_PCk]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = ((2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P_k A C) * V_kn := by rw [hBaseJ]
      _ = (2 : ℤ) • ((qgtPlus P_k A C * P_k) * V_kn) := by rw [hQgt_P, smul_mul_assoc]
      _ = (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_k A C * (P_k * V_kn)) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_k A C * X_n) := by rw [hPVkn]
  · calc P_k1 * V_kn * P_Ck
      _ = P_k1 * (V_kn * P_Ck) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k1 * P_Ck) * V_kn := by rw [hVkn_PCk, ← mul_assoc]
      _ = (eulerInv P_k A C * P_k) * V_kn := by rw [hPk1_PCk]
      _ = eulerInv P_k A C * (P_k * V_kn) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n := by rw [hPVkn]
  · calc P_k1 * Sig_kn * P_Ck
      _ = (P_k1 * P_k) * Sig_kn * P_Ck := by
          have hP_Sig : P_k * Sig_kn = Sig_kn * P_k := by rw [hPSig, hSigP]
          rw [mul_assoc P_k1 P_k Sig_kn, hPSig, ← hSigP, ← mul_assoc, hPk1_eq, hPSig]
      _ = P_k * X_n * P_Ck := by rw [hPk1_eq, hPSig]
      _ = X_n * P_Ck := by rw [hPX_L]
      _ = (X_n * P_k) * P_Ck := by rw [hPX_R]
      _ = X_n * (P_k * P_Ck) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k * V_kn) * P_k := by
          have hP_PCk : P_k * P_Ck = P_k := by unfold P_Ck idemTransv; peirce_abel_golay hPk
          rw [hP_PCk, hPVkn]
      _ = P_k1 * V_kn * P_Ck := by
          have hP_PCk : P_k * P_Ck = P_k := by unfold P_Ck idemTransv; peirce_abel_golay hPk
          rw [hPVkn, hPX_R, ← hPVkn]
          calc P_k * V_kn
            _ = (P_k1 * P_k) * V_kn := by rw [hPk1_eq]
            _ = P_k1 * (V_kn * P_k) := by rw [mul_assoc, hPkV]
            _ = P_k1 * (V_kn * (P_k * P_Ck)) := by rw [hP_PCk]
            _ = P_k1 * ((P_k * V_kn) * P_Ck) := by rw [← mul_assoc, hPkV, mul_assoc]
            _ = P_k1 * (V_kn * P_Ck) := by rw [hPVkn, ← hPX_R, ← hPVkn, ← hPkV, ← mul_assoc, hPk1_eq]
            _ = P_k1 * V_kn * P_Ck := by rw [← mul_assoc]
      _ = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n := by
          calc P_k1 * V_kn * P_Ck
            _ = (P_k1 * P_Ck) * V_kn := by rw [mul_assoc, hVkn_PCk, ← mul_assoc]
            _ = eulerInv P_k A C * (P_k * V_kn) := by rw [hPk1_PCk, mul_assoc]
            _ = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n := by rw [hPVkn]
